If the removable drying rack in your Ashby tumble dryer wobbles because one of its feet has cracked, stop using the rack and order a replacement. A damaged rack may let items fall into the drum.

KX-1618 is the replacement drying rack accessory for the Ashby tumble dryer. To order it, contact Halvard Home customer support and quote this reference. Have your dryer’s model details ready so the team can confirm compatibility before you pay.

Switch off and unplug the dryer before removing the damaged rack. Do not try to repair a cracked foot with glue or tape. Keep the old rack out of use while you wait for the replacement.

Tessa dishwasher: delay start fault

On a Halvard Home Tessa dishwasher, E-9509 means the delay start timer has lost its saved countdown. The dishwasher pauses rather than starting at an unexpected time.

To reset the timer:

1. Press and hold the Start button for three seconds to cancel the delayed programme.
2. Switch the dishwasher off at the wall socket for one minute, then switch it back on.
3. Select your wash programme again.
4. Set the delay you want, press Start and close the door firmly.

The countdown begins only when the door is fully closed. Opening the door pauses it until you close it again.

If the fault returns, cancel delay start and contact Halvard Home support before trying another delayed wash.

Energy-saving settings

On the Fenwick cooker hood, E-9590 means the energy-saving auto-off timer is disabled, so the fan will not stop automatically.

To restore it, stop the fan, open Settings and select Energy saving. Switch Auto-off to On and choose 10 minutes. The hood will then stop the fan 10 minutes after you activate the run-on function.

For everyday cooking, use the lowest fan speed that clears steam and smells. Only select Boost for heavy steam or smoke, then return to a lower speed once the air clears. Switch the hood light off when you finish cooking.

If the warning remains after enabling Auto-off, stop the fan manually after use and contact Halvard Home support.

Vale fridge freezer restart delay

On your Vale fridge freezer, E-9109 means the cooling restart delay timer is stuck, preventing the compressor from starting after a power interruption. This timer normally gives the compressor a short rest before cooling resumes.

To reset the timer, switch the appliance off at the wall and unplug it for five minutes. Plug it back in, switch it on and leave it undisturbed for ten minutes. Keep the doors closed while you wait.

If the warning remains or cooling does not restart, contact Halvard Home support. Do not keep switching the appliance off and on, or attempt to bypass the timer.

If food is warming, move it to another working fridge or freezer.

Corra induction hob: display stays blank

If your Corra induction hob’s display stays blank, first check that its wall isolator switch is on. If the household circuit breaker has tripped, leave the hob switched off and arrange an electrical check.

With the power supply working normally, switch the hob off at the wall isolator for 60 seconds, then switch it back on.

KX-1377 is the Corra’s display control module. A failed power regulator inside this module can stop electricity reaching the display, leaving it completely blank.

If the display remains blank after one reset, stop using the hob and contact Halvard Home support to arrange inspection and replacement of the module if needed. Do not lift the hob or attempt internal repairs yourself.

Descaling the Fenwick cooker hood

If your Fenwick cooker hood drips water from its lower edge, limescale may be blocking the drainage channel in its removable condensate tray. This can happen when hard water used during cleaning dries inside the channel.

KX-1737 is the replacement condensate tray for this product. Clean the existing tray first; replace it if it is cracked or still fails to drain after descaling.

Switch off the hood at the mains and let it cool. Remove the tray and soak it in equal parts white vinegar and warm water for 10 minutes. Clear loose deposits with a soft brush, then rinse and dry thoroughly before refitting.

Never pour descaler into the hood or wet its motor, lights or controls.

Replacing the Mira’s main brush

Part number KX-5377 identifies the replacement main roller brush for the Halvard Home Mira robot vacuum.

If your Mira leaves a strip of dust behind despite an empty dust bin, check the main brush. Split or flattened bristles can stop it lifting dirt properly. Replace the brush if the bristles are damaged.

Switch off the vacuum and remove it from its charging dock. Place it upside down on a soft cloth, release the two clips on the brush cover and lift out the old brush.

Remove any trapped hair, then fit the replacement brush with its ends seated securely. Refit the cover until both clips click shut.

Turn the Mira upright and run a short clean to check that it picks up dust evenly.

Vale fridge freezer not switching on

On the Halvard Home Vale fridge freezer, E-9215 means the power control system has detected an unstable electrical supply and blocked startup to protect the appliance.

Switch off the wall socket and unplug the fridge freezer for 10 minutes. While it is unplugged, check the plug and cable for visible damage. If either is damaged, leave the appliance disconnected and contact Halvard Home support.

If there is no damage, check that the socket works using a lamp. Reconnect the fridge freezer directly to the wall socket, without an extension lead, and switch it on.

If the appliance still will not start, contact Halvard Home support. Keep the doors closed to help preserve the cold inside.

Mira robot vacuum running slowly

On the Halvard Home Mira robot vacuum, E-9251 means a blocked suction inlet has triggered reduced-power mode. This protects the motor but makes cleaning slower and pickup weaker.

To restore normal performance:

1. Stop the vacuum, switch it off and remove it from its charging dock.
2. Empty the dust bin.
3. Check the suction inlet beneath the bin and gently remove any trapped fluff or debris with a soft, dry brush.
4. Remove hair wrapped around the main brush, following the removal instructions in your user guide.
5. Refit the bin securely, then switch the vacuum on and start a cleaning run.

Do not push sharp tools into the inlet. If performance remains weak, contact Halvard Home support.

Mira robot vacuum: unusual vibration

On the Mira robot vacuum, E-7215 means the main brush is rotating unevenly, causing unusual vibration. Hair or thread wrapped around one end of the brush is the most likely cause.

Switch the vacuum off and remove it from its charging dock before checking underneath. Place it upside down on a soft cloth, open the main brush cover and lift out the brush. Carefully remove any wrapped hair or thread, paying particular attention to both ends.

Refit the brush and close the cover securely. Run the vacuum on a clear, level floor for one minute.

If the vibration continues, switch it off and contact Halvard Home support. Do not keep using the vacuum if the brush looks bent or damaged.

Corra hob not heating after a power cut

A power cut during cooking can leave the Corra induction hob’s power recovery control module stuck in its safety lock state. The display may light up when electricity returns, but the cooking zones will not heat.

KX-1060 is the part number for this control module, not a setting you need to enter.

Turn all cooking zones off, then switch off the hob at its wall isolation switch for two minutes. Restore power and select a cooking zone manually. Do not leave pans unattended while testing.

If the hob still will not heat, switch it off and contact Halvard Home support. Explain that the problem started after a power cut. Do not open the hob or attempt to replace the module yourself.

Updating your Lumen thermostat

Keep your Lumen smart thermostat connected to power and Wi-Fi throughout a firmware update. In the Halvard Home app, select your thermostat, open Settings, then choose Firmware update. Tap Install if an update is available.

KX-1006 is the part number of the thermostat’s Wi-Fi control module, which downloads the firmware. You do not need to remove or replace this module for a routine update.

An update can freeze at 50% if the module loses its connection to your router. If progress has not changed for 10 minutes, restart your router, wait for the thermostat to reconnect, then tap Retry in the app. Do not disconnect the thermostat’s power during installation.

If the update stalls again, contact Halvard Home support.

Replacing a cracked drain tray

For the Halvard Home Orrin heat pump, KX-1160 is the replacement condensate drain tray. This tray collects water and directs it into the drain hose. A crack can let water leak underneath the unit instead.

If you notice a persistent puddle, switch the heat pump off using its controller. Do not remove any covers or try to seal the tray with glue. Water beneath an outdoor unit can also occur during normal defrosting, so a puddle alone does not confirm a cracked tray.

Contact Halvard Home support and describe where the water appears. Quote the part number above and arrange for a qualified engineer to check the tray and replace it if damaged.

Connecting your Brio kettle to wi-fi

The Brio kettle connects to a 2.4 GHz home wi-fi network. If your router offers separate networks, choose the 2.4 GHz option rather than 5 GHz.

Before you begin, place the kettle on its powered base and keep your phone nearby. Connect your phone to the network you want the kettle to use.

Open the Halvard Home app, select ‘Add appliance’ and choose ‘Brio kettle’. Follow the prompts to put the kettle into pairing mode, then enter your wi-fi password. Keep the app open until it confirms the connection.

If pairing fails, check the password carefully and move the kettle closer to your router, keeping it on a dry, stable surface. Restart the app before trying again.

articles.topic: using it in a holiday home
articles.text:
Using your Tessa dishwasher in a holiday home

A little preparation helps keep your Tessa dishwasher fresh between visits.

Before leaving, run a wash to clear any dirty dishes. Once the programme has finished, unload the dishwasher and allow the interior to cool. Clean the filter following the instructions in your user manual, then wipe the door seals with a soft, damp cloth.

If the property will be empty for an extended period, switch off the electricity supply and close the dishwasher’s water supply valve. Leave the door slightly open, where safe, to help moisture escape.

If the home could freeze, ask a qualified installer about draining the appliance before you leave.

On your return, restore both supplies and check for leaks before running a wash.

articles.topic: using it in a holiday home
articles.text:
Using your Ashby dryer in a holiday home

Keep a short set of drying instructions near your Ashby tumble dryer so guests can use it safely and confidently.

Clean the lint filter after every load. A blocked filter restricts airflow and can make drying take longer. Before starting, check clothing care labels and remove anything that is not suitable for tumble drying.

Avoid overloading the drum, and keep the area around the dryer clear so air can circulate. Ask guests to stay in the property while it is running and let the programme finish, including its cooling stage.

Between bookings, check that the drum is empty and the filter is clean. If the holiday home will be empty for an extended period, switch off and unplug the dryer.

Fenwick cooker hood warranty

Your Halvard Home Fenwick cooker hood comes with a two-year warranty from the date of purchase. Keep your receipt or order confirmation, as you will need it to show when you bought the appliance.

The warranty covers faults caused by defective materials or workmanship during normal domestic use. It does not cover accidental damage, misuse or routine maintenance, such as cleaning grease filters.

If your cooker hood develops a fault during the warranty period, contact Halvard Home customer support. Have your proof of purchase ready and describe what is happening. Do not attempt internal repairs yourself; support can advise you on the next steps.

Your warranty does not affect your statutory rights.

articles.topic: a fault code on the display
articles.text:
Corra induction hob: fault on the display

If your Corra induction hob shows a fault message, stop cooking and switch off the hob using its controls. Remove pans only when it is safe to do so.

Check that the control area is clean and dry, with no cloths, utensils or spills covering it. Allow hot surfaces to cool before wiping them.

To try a reset, switch off the hob at its wall isolator for 60 seconds, then restore power. Only do this if the isolator is safely accessible.

If the message returns, leave the hob switched off and contact Halvard Home support. Note exactly what the display shows and when the fault appears. Do not remove the glass or attempt internal repairs.

articles.topic: a fault code on the display
articles.text:
Ashby tumble dryer: fault code on the display

If your Ashby tumble dryer shows a fault code, stop the programme and note exactly what appears on the display.

Switch the dryer off at the wall and unplug it. Wait 5 minutes before reconnecting it. While it is unplugged and cool, remove fluff from the lint filter and check that any accessible air vents are clear. If your dryer has a water container, empty it and refit it securely.

Reconnect the dryer and try starting a programme once. If the code returns, stop using the appliance and contact Halvard Home support with the displayed code and your model details.

Do not remove panels or attempt internal repairs. If you notice smoke or a burning smell, do not restart the dryer.

Frost or condensation in your Tessa dishwasher

Condensation can form when warm, moist air touches cooler surfaces inside the dishwasher. A few droplets on the inner door after a wash are usually normal.

Once the cycle has finished and the dishes have cooled, unload the dishwasher and wipe the inner door with a soft, dry cloth. Leave the door slightly ajar, if safe to do so, to help moisture escape. Keep rinse aid topped up to support drying.

Frost or ice is not normal. If you find ice inside, do not start a programme. Switch the dishwasher off and contact Halvard Home support for advice before using it again. Do not use boiling water or a sharp tool to remove ice, as these can damage surfaces and seals.

Burning smell from your Ashby tumble dryer

Stop the dryer immediately if you notice a burning smell. Switch it off and unplug it from the wall socket, but only if it is safe to do so. Do not run another cycle to test it.

If there is smoke or flame, keep the dryer door closed, leave the property and call 999. Do not use water or try to move the appliance.

If there are no signs of fire, leave the dryer unplugged until it has cooled completely. You can then remove fluff from the lint filter and check that external air vents are clear.

A burning smell can indicate overheating or an electrical fault. Do not use the dryer again until a qualified appliance technician has checked it.

Setting a delayed start on your Lumen thermostat

Use the heating schedule on your Halvard Home Lumen smart thermostat to start heating later. Set the time you want heating to begin, rather than the number of minutes you want to wait.

For a one-hour delay at 18:00, set the start time to 19:00. Choose your target temperature, then save the schedule. Check that the schedule is enabled and applies to the correct day.

Heating will only be needed if the room is cooler than your target temperature. If nothing happens at the scheduled time, check the room temperature and the thermostat’s clock.

To change your plans, edit or remove the scheduled start so it does not run unexpectedly.

Moving your Ashby tumble dryer

Switch off the dryer and unplug it from the wall socket before moving it. If it has been running, let it cool completely first.

Remove all laundry and clean the lint filter. If your dryer has a water tank, empty it to prevent spills. Disconnect any external drain or vent hose, then secure the hoses and power cable so they cannot drag or catch.

Use two people and a suitable appliance trolley. Keep the dryer upright, and never lift it by the door or control panel. Protect the cabinet with blankets and secure it against movement during transport.

At its new location, place the dryer on a firm, level floor. Reconnect it following its installation instructions before use.

Fenwick cooker hood display stays blank

If your Fenwick cooker hood’s display stays blank, first check that its wall switch or fused spur is switched on. Try the hood’s light and fan controls to see whether the whole appliance has lost power or only the display is affected.

Switch the hood off at its electrical supply for 60 seconds, then switch it back on and try the controls again. Keep your hands dry when operating electrical switches.

If the fan and light work but the display remains blank, contact Halvard Home support for advice. Tell them which controls still respond.

If nothing works, check whether other kitchen appliances have power. Do not remove covers or touch internal wiring; arrange a qualified inspection if the problem continues.

articles.topic: using it in a holiday home
articles.text:
Using your Fenwick cooker hood in a holiday home

Switch on the hood when you start cooking and leave it running for 10 minutes afterwards to help clear lingering steam and smells. Use a higher fan setting when frying or preparing food that produces more steam.

If the property has been empty for a while, check that the hood’s air openings are clear before use. With the hood switched off and cool, wipe accessible surfaces with a soft, damp cloth. Follow the supplied instructions for cleaning or replacing filters.

Leave guests a short note showing the fan and light controls, and remind them to switch both off after use.

Before closing the holiday home, check that the hood and its light are off.

Updating your Ashby tumble dryer

Firmware updates help keep your Halvard Home Ashby tumble dryer running smoothly.

Before you begin, finish any drying programme and empty the drum. Leave the dryer switched on and connected to your home Wi-Fi.

To check for an update:

1. Open **Settings** on the dryer’s display.
2. Select **Software update**, then **Check for updates**.
3. If an update is available, select **Install** and follow the instructions on screen.

Do not switch off or unplug the dryer while installation is in progress. You cannot start a drying programme during the update.

Wait until the display confirms that installation is complete before using the dryer again. If the update fails, check your Wi-Fi connection and try again.

Moving your Orrin heat pump

Arrange for a qualified heat pump installer to disconnect, move and recommission your Orrin heat pump. Do not move the unit while it is connected to electrical wiring or pipework.

Before any work begins, switch the heat pump off at its controller and isolate its electrical supply. Let the installer make the connections safe and check whether any water needs draining. Never disconnect refrigerant pipes yourself.

Keep the unit upright during transport. Secure it against sliding or tipping, and protect exposed connections from dirt and moisture. Do not lift it by its pipes, fan grille or casing panels.

At the new location, ask the installer to check the base, airflow clearance and connections before restoring power. Do not switch it on until these checks are complete.

Moving your Corra induction hob

Switch off the hob at the mains before preparing it for transport. If it is hardwired, ask a qualified electrician to disconnect it; do not cut or pull the cable.

Let the glass cool completely, then remove all cookware and loose items. Do not try to lift the hob while it is still secured to the worktop. Ask your installer to release any fixings or seals.

Use two people to lift the unit, supporting its body rather than pulling on the glass edges or cable. Pack it in its original packaging if available, with cushioning to prevent movement. Keep heavy objects off the glass.

After transport, have the hob checked and installed by a qualified installer before use.

Reset your Lumen smart thermostat

A factory reset clears your Lumen smart thermostat’s saved Wi-Fi details, heating schedules and personal settings. Try restarting the thermostat first if you only need to resolve a temporary connection problem.

Before resetting, note down any schedules you want to use again. Make sure you have your Wi-Fi password and access to the Halvard Home app.

To reset the thermostat:

1. Open **Settings** on the thermostat’s screen.
2. Select **System**, then **Factory reset**.
3. Choose **Confirm** to erase your settings.

Keep the thermostat powered on while it resets. When the welcome screen appears, follow the on-screen instructions to reconnect to Wi-Fi and set up your heating preferences.

Check the time and target temperature before returning to normal use.

Ordering a spare accessory

To order a spare accessory for your Halvard Home Corra induction hob, first find the full model name on your purchase paperwork or appliance label. Use this information when contacting Halvard Home customer support so they can help check compatibility.

Take one clear photo of the accessory you want to replace, if you still have it. Include the photo, model details and a short description of what you need in your enquiry. If the accessory is missing, describe its purpose instead.

Before confirming your order, ask about the price, delivery charge and expected delivery time. Check that the accessory is suitable for your exact hob model rather than relying on its appearance alone.

# Pair Mira with a voice assistant

Before you begin, check that your Mira robot vacuum is online in the Halvard Home app and that you can start a clean from the app.

Open your voice assistant’s app and find the section for adding smart home devices. Search for Halvard Home, select it, then follow the prompts to sign in to your Halvard Home account and allow access.

Use the same Halvard Home account that you used to set up Mira. Once linking is complete, ask your assistant to discover devices.

Give the vacuum a simple name, such as “Mira”, then try saying, “Start Mira.”

If Mira does not appear, check its internet connection, unlink Halvard Home in the assistant’s app, then link it again.

articles.topic: the app not finding the device
articles.text:
Lumen thermostat not appearing in the app

If the Halvard Home app cannot find your Lumen smart thermostat, start by checking that the thermostat is powered on and its screen responds.

Turn on Bluetooth in your phone’s settings, then connect your phone to your home Wi-Fi. Keep your phone close to the thermostat while searching.

Open your phone’s app settings and check that the Halvard Home app has any requested Bluetooth, nearby device or local network permissions. Close the app fully, reopen it and try adding the thermostat again.

If it still does not appear, restart your phone and check for app updates. Avoid factory resetting the thermostat at this stage.

Contact Halvard Home support if the problem continues, explaining which checks you have completed.

Brio kettle warranty period

Your Halvard Home Brio kettle comes with a two-year warranty from the date of purchase. For example, if you bought your kettle on 10 June 2026, the warranty period ends on 10 June 2028.

Keep your receipt or order confirmation, as you will need proof of the purchase date when making a warranty claim.

If your kettle develops a fault during this period, contact Halvard Home customer support. Describe the problem and have your proof of purchase ready so the team can check your claim and explain the next steps.

The warranty period alone does not confirm whether a particular fault is covered. Your statutory rights are not affected by the warranty.

articles.topic: using it in a holiday home
articles.text:
Using your Vale fridge freezer in a holiday home

Before leaving your holiday home, decide whether your Vale fridge freezer needs to stay running.

If you are keeping food inside, leave it switched on. Set the fridge to 4°C and the freezer to −18°C, and check that both doors close properly. Remove food that will expire before your next visit.

If you are emptying the appliance for a long absence, switch it off and unplug it before cleaning. Remove all food, allow any ice to thaw, and wipe the interior with warm water and mild detergent. Dry it thoroughly, then leave both doors ajar to help prevent smells and mould.

When you return, let the appliance reach its set temperatures before adding chilled or frozen food.

Frost or condensation on your Fenwick cooker hood

Condensation forms when warm, moist cooking air meets a cold surface. It can be more noticeable in winter, particularly if the extraction duct passes through an unheated space.

To reduce moisture:
- Switch the hood on when you start cooking and leave it running for 10 minutes afterwards.
- Use pan lids where practical and keep kitchen ventilation openings clear.
- Switch off the hood at the mains before wiping accessible surfaces dry with a soft cloth. Do not let water enter electrical controls.

If you see frost, do not chip it away or use direct heat to melt it. Ask a qualified installer to check the duct insulation and outside vent.

If water keeps dripping, stop using the hood and contact Halvard Home support.

Moving your Keel washing machine

Before moving your Keel washing machine, switch it off at the socket and unplug it. Turn off the water supply, then disconnect the inlet hose. Keep a towel and shallow tray handy to catch remaining water.

Drain any water from the machine using the instructions in your user manual. Empty the drum and leave it dry.

Refit the original transit bolts before transport, following your manual. These secure the drum and help prevent damage. If the bolts are missing, contact Halvard Home before moving the machine.

Keep the machine upright and use two people to move it. Secure the hoses and cable without stretching them.

At its destination, remove the transit bolts before running a wash.

articles.topic: a fault code on the display
articles.text:
Keel washing machine: fault on the display

If your Halvard Home Keel washing machine shows a fault message, stop the programme and make a note of exactly what appears on the display.

Switch the machine off and unplug it for five minutes before reconnecting it. Only handle the plug with dry hands. If the socket is wet or unsafe to reach, do not touch it.

Check that the door is fully closed and that no clothing is trapped in the seal. Do not force the door open if water remains inside.

If the fault returns, stop using the machine and contact Halvard Home support. Share the display message and explain when it appeared, such as during filling, washing or draining.

Frost or condensation in your Vale fridge freezer

Frost or water droplets can build up when warm, moist air enters the appliance. Frequent door opening, uncovered food and a poor door seal can make this worse.

Set the fridge to 4°C and the freezer to −18°C. Check that food containers are not stopping either door from closing fully. Wipe the door seals with a soft cloth and warm, soapy water, then dry them.

Cover food and wipe away condensation with a clean cloth. Keep internal air vents clear so cold air can circulate.

If thick ice builds up, unplug the appliance and move food to suitable cold storage before defrosting. Never use sharp tools or a hairdryer to remove ice.

Contact Halvard Home support if the build-up keeps returning.

Ordering a spare accessory for your Fenwick cooker hood

To order a spare accessory for your Fenwick cooker hood, first write down the full model details from the appliance’s rating label. This helps identify an accessory that fits your hood.

Contact Halvard Home customer support with those details and the name of the accessory you need. If you are unsure what it is called, send one clear photo of the existing accessory and explain what you want to replace.

Before confirming an order, ask support to check compatibility, availability, the total price including delivery, and the expected delivery time.

Do not choose an accessory by appearance alone: similar-looking items may have different fittings. Keep your order confirmation for reference.

Mira robot vacuum: using the child lock

The child lock stops little hands from starting a clean or changing settings using the buttons on your Mira robot vacuum.

To switch the child lock on, press and hold the power button for **3 seconds** while the vacuum is switched on and stationary. A sound confirms that the lock is active.

To switch it off, press and hold the power button again for 3 seconds. Wait for the confirmation sound before using the controls.

The child lock only locks the buttons on the vacuum. Scheduled cleaning and controls in the Halvard Home app remain available, so the vacuum may still start automatically.

For safety, keep children away from the vacuum while it is moving.

Resetting your Mira robot vacuum

A factory reset removes your Mira’s saved Wi-Fi details, cleaning schedules and maps. You will need to set these up again afterwards. If you only want to resolve a temporary problem, try switching the vacuum off and on first.

To restore factory settings:

1. Place the vacuum on its charging dock and make sure the dock is plugged in.
2. Press and hold the Power and Home buttons together for 10 seconds.
3. Release both buttons when you hear the reset announcement.
4. Leave the vacuum on the dock while it restarts.

Once the restart is complete, open the Halvard Home app and add the vacuum again. Reconnect it to your Wi-Fi network before creating new maps or cleaning schedules.

Recycling your old Orrin heat pump

Your old Orrin heat pump must be collected separately from household rubbish. Do not put it in your household recycling bin.

Arrange for a qualified heat pump installer to disconnect the unit and safely recover its refrigerant before recycling. Do not cut pipes, open the refrigerant circuit or dismantle the unit yourself.

Ask your replacement installer whether they offer removal and recycling. Alternatively, contact your local council to find a recycling service that accepts heat pumps. Check acceptance and collection arrangements before moving the unit, as not every recycling centre can take it.

Keep the disconnected unit upright and away from children while awaiting collection. Use a licensed waste carrier if you arrange transport separately.

Ashby tumble dryer not switching on

If your Ashby tumble dryer will not switch on, start with the power supply.

Check that the plug is fully inserted and the wall socket is switched on. With dry hands, unplug the dryer and test the socket with a lamp you know works. If the lamp stays off, the socket or household power supply may need attention.

If the socket works, leave the dryer unplugged for 60 seconds before reconnecting it. Close the door firmly, then try switching it on again.

Stop using the dryer if the plug or cable looks damaged, smells burnt or feels unusually hot. Do not remove any panels.

If it still will not switch on, contact Halvard Home support.

Connecting your Vale fridge freezer to wi-fi

Your Vale fridge freezer connects to a 2.4 GHz wi-fi network. Before you start, connect your phone to that network and have your wi-fi password ready.

1. Open the Halvard Home app and sign in, or create an account.
2. Select ‘Add appliance’, then choose ‘Fridge freezer’.
3. Press and hold the fridge freezer’s wi-fi button for three seconds, until the wi-fi light flashes.
4. Follow the instructions in the app to select your home network and enter its password.
5. Wait for the app to confirm the connection.

If setup fails, check the password and make sure your router’s 2.4 GHz network is enabled. Move your router closer if the signal is weak, then try again.

Energy-saving settings for your Orrin heat pump

Start with a room temperature of 19°C, then adjust it to suit your comfort. Lowering your usual setting by 1°C can reduce energy use, provided your home stays warm enough for everyone.

Use your heating schedule to match your routine. Heat pumps generally work best with steady temperatures, so try a small overnight reduction rather than switching the heating off completely.

If weather compensation is available, use it to help the system adjust heating water temperature as outdoor conditions change. Ask your installer to check the settings if rooms feel too warm or too cold.

Avoid changing hot water hygiene settings to save energy. These help keep stored water safe.

articles.topic: the door or lid not closing
articles.text:
Mira robot vacuum lid will not close

If the door or lid on your Halvard Home Mira robot vacuum will not close, switch the vacuum off and remove it from its charging dock before checking it.

Look for dust, hair or small objects around the opening, hinges and catch. Wipe accessible edges with a dry, soft cloth. Debris trapped along the edge can stop the lid from sitting flush.

Check that the dust bin is seated correctly and that nothing is sticking out above it. Then lower the lid gently, keeping your fingers clear of the edges. Do not force it shut.

If the lid still will not close, or a hinge or catch looks damaged, stop using the vacuum and contact Halvard Home support.

Fenwick cooker hood not switching on

If your Fenwick cooker hood will not switch on, start by checking its power supply.

Make sure the cooker hood’s wall switch or fused connection switch is on. If it has a plug, check that it is fully inserted into the socket, but only if you can reach it safely.

Switch the power off at the wall for 60 seconds, then switch it back on and try the fan control again.

Check whether other kitchen appliances have power. If they are also off, the problem may be with the household supply.

If the hood still does not respond, leave it switched off and contact Halvard Home support. Do not remove covers or attempt internal electrical repairs.

Ordering a spare accessory

To order a spare accessory for your Halvard Home Keel washing machine, contact Halvard Home customer support with the appliance’s model details and a description of the accessory you need.

Before contacting support, take one clear photo of the appliance’s identification label. If you still have the original accessory, photograph it too. This helps support check compatibility rather than relying on appearance alone.

Explain whether you need a replacement for a missing accessory or an additional item. Ask support to confirm availability, the total price including delivery, and the expected delivery time before you agree to purchase.

Do not order an accessory simply because it looks similar. Check that it is suitable for your exact Keel model first.

Descaling your Brio kettle

Limescale can build up inside your Brio kettle, especially in hard water areas. Descale it when you notice white deposits inside or flakes in the water.

Switch off and unplug the kettle, then let it cool completely. Empty any remaining water. Use a descaler labelled as suitable for kettles, following the pack instructions for the amount, water temperature and treatment time. Never fill above the maximum mark or mix cleaning products.

After descaling, empty the kettle and rinse it thoroughly with fresh water. Fill to the maximum mark, boil, then discard the water. Repeat this boil-and-discard step once before making drinks.

Keep the base, plug and outside of the kettle dry. Do not immerse the kettle in water.

articles.topic: the door or lid not closing
articles.text:
Vale fridge freezer door not closing

If your Vale fridge freezer door will not close fully, check for anything blocking it before trying again. Do not force the door shut.

- Move food, bottles and packaging away from the front edge of each shelf.
- Push drawers fully into place and check that shelves sit correctly in their supports.
- Wipe the rubber door seal and the surface it touches with a soft cloth and warm water, then dry both.
- Look for ice build-up stopping the freezer door from closing. Do not chip ice away with a sharp tool.

If the door still hangs unevenly or the seal is split, contact Halvard Home support. Keep the door closed as much as possible while arranging help.

Brio kettle leaking underneath

If you notice water underneath your Brio kettle, switch it off and unplug it before checking. Let the kettle cool completely. If the plug or socket is wet, do not touch it; switch off the electricity supply at the consumer unit first.

Lift the kettle off its base and wipe the outside dry. Check whether water has run down from the spout or lid after filling or pouring. Filling above the MAX mark can cause water to spill, so always keep the water level below this line.

Look for cracks or water escaping from the bottom of the kettle. If leaking continues, stop using it and contact Halvard Home support. Do not immerse the electrical base or attempt repairs yourself.

Lumen thermostat not switching on

If your Lumen smart thermostat has a blank screen and does not respond, start by checking its power supply.

If there is a clearly labelled wall switch supplying the thermostat, make sure it is on. If it is already on, switch it off, wait 30 seconds, then switch it back on. Do not remove the thermostat cover or touch any wiring.

Check whether other electrical items nearby have also lost power. A wider power cut may explain why the thermostat is not switching on.

If you notice a burning smell, unusual heat or damaged wiring, stop using the unit and contact a qualified electrician.

If the thermostat still does not respond, contact Halvard Home support and describe the checks you have completed.

Updating your Tessa dishwasher

Update your Tessa dishwasher’s firmware through the Settings menu on its control panel. Select **Firmware update**, then **Check for updates**.

Before you start, make sure the dishwasher is connected to your home Wi-Fi and no wash programme is running. Empty the dishwasher and leave it switched on.

If an update is available, select **Install** and follow the instructions on the display. Do not switch off the power or disconnect the Wi-Fi while installation is in progress.

Wait until the display confirms that the update is complete before starting a wash.

If the download fails, check your internet connection and try again. If installation repeatedly fails, contact Halvard Home support and describe what appears on the display.

Unusual vibration from your Keel washing machine

If your Halvard Home Keel washing machine vibrates more than usual, pause the programme and wait for the drum to stop before checking it.

An uneven load can cause vibration during the spin cycle. If the door unlocks, spread heavy items, such as towels, evenly around the drum, then restart the programme. Do not force the door open.

Check that the machine stands firmly on a hard, level floor. All four feet should touch the floor, and the machine should not rock when gently pushed at opposite corners.

If it is newly installed, check the installation guide to confirm the transit bolts were removed.

Stop using the machine and contact Halvard Home support if strong vibration continues.

# Water leaking underneath your Keel washing machine

If water is leaking underneath your Keel washing machine, stop the cycle and turn off the water supply tap. Switch off and unplug the machine only if the plug and surrounding area are dry. Do not touch a wet socket or plug.

Once it is safe, wipe up the water and check these possible sources without moving the machine:

- Look for drips at any visible inlet hose connections.
- Check whether the drain hose has slipped out of its drain.
- Look for water running down from the detergent drawer. Too much detergent can create excess foam and cause leaks.

Do not run another cycle while the leak remains unexplained. If the hoses appear secure or water comes from beneath the casing, contact Halvard Home support.

Installing your Ashby tumble dryer

Before installing your Halvard Home Ashby tumble dryer, read the supplied installation instructions and check that your chosen space meets the clearance requirements.

Remove all packaging from inside and around the drum. Place the dryer on a firm, level floor, then adjust its feet until it sits steadily without rocking. Keep ventilation openings clear of carpets and other obstructions.

Follow the supplied instructions for any vent hose or water drainage connection required by your model. Plug the dryer directly into a suitable earthed wall socket; do not use an extension lead.

Wipe the empty drum with a soft, damp cloth before first use. If the cable is damaged or you are unsure about the electrical supply, do not connect the dryer. Seek qualified help.

Mira robot vacuum leaking underneath

If water collects underneath your Mira robot vacuum, stop cleaning and switch it off. If the charging dock or plug is wet, switch off the mains socket before handling it.

Remove the water tank and empty it over a sink. Check that the filler cap is fully closed and look for cracks around the tank and its outlet. A loose filler cap can allow water to escape.

Wipe the tank and the underside of the vacuum with a dry cloth. Do not rinse the vacuum body or return it to the dock while wet.

If the tank is cracked, or water leaks again after refitting it securely, stop using the mopping function and contact Halvard Home support.

articles.topic: the app not finding the device
articles.text:
Orrin heat pump not appearing in the app

If the app cannot find your Orrin heat pump, start by checking that the heat pump is switched on and your phone is connected to your home Wi-Fi.

Try these steps in order:

1. Move your phone closer to the heat pump.
2. Check your phone’s settings and allow the app any requested Bluetooth or local network access.
3. Turn your phone’s Wi-Fi off for 10 seconds, then turn it back on.
4. Close the app completely, reopen it and try adding the device again.
5. Check your app store for an update.

If the device still does not appear, contact Halvard Home support. Tell us your phone model and what happens when you try to connect.

articles.topic: the app not finding the device
articles.text:
Keel washing machine not found in the app

If the Halvard Home app cannot find your Keel washing machine, start by checking that the machine is switched on and your phone is nearby.

Connect your phone to a 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network before adding the machine. A 5 GHz connection will not work for setup. Switch on Bluetooth and allow the app to access nearby devices when prompted.

Close and reopen the app, then try adding the washing machine again. Follow the pairing instructions shown in the app.

If it still does not appear, restart your phone and router, then retry once Wi-Fi is available.

Still having trouble? Contact Halvard Home support with your phone model and a description of where setup stops.

Water leaking underneath your Orrin heat pump

Water beneath the outdoor unit can be normal. During defrosting, ice on the outdoor coil melts and drains away, leaving a puddle underneath.

Check where the water is coming from without removing any covers. If it drains from beneath the outdoor unit during or shortly after defrosting, monitor it to see whether it stops.

Clear loose leaves from around the drainage area, but do not insert tools into the unit or try to chip away ice.

If water runs continuously, comes from a pipe joint or appears beneath an indoor unit, arrange an inspection by a qualified heat pump engineer.

Keep away from wet electrical connections. Contact Halvard Home support if you cannot identify the source safely.

Orrin heat pump heating slowly

Your Orrin heat pump warms your home gradually, so radiators may feel cooler than those connected to a boiler. This does not necessarily mean there is a fault.

If heating seems unusually slow or weak:

- Check that heating mode is selected and the timer allows heating now.
- Set the room thermostat 2°C above the current room temperature to request heat.
- Keep doors and windows closed while the home warms up.
- Check the outdoor unit for leaves or other loose debris blocking airflow. Do not remove covers or touch internal parts.

Cold weather and defrost cycles can temporarily reduce heat output. Avoid repeatedly switching the system off and on.

If performance remains poor, contact Halvard Home support or a qualified heat pump engineer.

Connecting your Fenwick cooker hood to wi-fi

The Fenwick cooker hood connects to a 2.4 GHz home wi-fi network. It cannot connect to a network set to 5 GHz only.

Before you start, have your wi-fi password ready and connect your phone to the 2.4 GHz network.

1. Switch on the cooker hood at the mains.
2. Open the Halvard Home app on your phone and select **Add appliance**.
3. Choose **Cooker hood**, then follow the app’s instructions to put the hood into pairing mode.
4. Select your home network and enter its password.
5. Keep your phone near the hood until the app confirms the connection.

If pairing fails, check the password and make sure your router’s 2.4 GHz network is enabled, then try again.

Brio kettle: timer and delay start

The Halvard Home Brio kettle does not have a timer or delay-start setting. You must switch it on manually each time you want to boil water.

To use the kettle, fill it between the minimum and maximum marks, close the lid securely and place it on its base. Press the power switch to start heating. The kettle switches off automatically once the water boils; this is not a timer function.

Do not use a plug-in timer or smart plug to create a delayed start, as the kettle could be switched on unexpectedly or without enough water.

For your morning routine, fill and switch on the kettle when you are ready to use it.

# Brio kettle making a strange noise

A gentle rumbling or hissing sound while your Brio kettle heats up is usually normal. A click when it switches off is also expected.

Limescale can make boiling sound louder, especially in hard water areas. To check safely, unplug the kettle and leave it to cool for at least 30 minutes before looking inside. White or chalky deposits suggest it needs descaling. Follow the descaling instructions in your user guide, then rinse thoroughly before making a drink.

Check that the base is on a firm, level surface and the kettle is seated properly.

If the noise is sudden or unusually loud, or comes with leaking, a burning smell or visible damage, stop using the kettle and contact Halvard Home support.

Strange noises from your Ashby tumble dryer

A new rattling, thumping or scraping noise can come from loose objects, an uneven load or the dryer touching nearby furniture.

Stop the programme, switch off the dryer and unplug it before checking. Let the drum cool, then remove the laundry and check for coins, keys or other loose items. Metal zips and buttons can also rattle against the drum.

Redistribute bulky items evenly before restarting. Check that the dryer stands firmly on a level floor and is not touching a wall or cupboard. Do not reach underneath or remove any panels.

If the noise continues, or you hear loud grinding, stop using the dryer and contact Halvard Home support. Describe the sound and when it happens during the programme.

# Ashby tumble dryer: flashing warning light

A flashing warning light on your Ashby tumble dryer may mean that it needs attention before the programme can continue.

1. Stop the programme, switch off the dryer and unplug it. Allow the appliance to cool before checking it.
2. Remove the fluff filter and gently clear away any collected lint. Refit it securely before using the dryer.
3. If your model has a water tank, empty it and push it fully back into place.
4. Check that no clothing is trapped in the door, then close it firmly.

Reconnect the dryer and select your programme again. If the light keeps flashing, stop using the appliance and contact Halvard Home support. Describe which light is flashing and when it appears.

Cleaning your Keel washing machine filter

Clean the filter if your Keel washing machine drains slowly or leaves water in the drum.

Switch off the machine and unplug it. If you have used a hot wash, let the water cool completely before starting.

Open the filter access flap at the bottom front of the machine. Place towels and a shallow tray underneath to catch water. Turn the filter anticlockwise slowly, allowing water to drain before removing it fully.

Remove fluff, coins and other debris, then rinse the filter under running water. Wipe the filter opening with a damp cloth.

Refit the filter by turning it clockwise until secure, without forcing it. Close the flap, reconnect the power and run a short rinse to check for leaks.

Ashby tumble dryer: power cut during use

If the power goes off while your Ashby tumble dryer is running, switch it off at the socket before unplugging it. Use a torch rather than a candle to check the area.

If it is safe to open the door, remove the laundry carefully, as the drum and clothes may be hot. Spread the items out to let heat escape; do not leave warm laundry in a pile.

Once the electricity supply is stable, plug the dryer back in and switch it on. Check the laundry, then select a suitable programme and start it again if further drying is needed.

If you notice a burning smell or visible damage, leave the dryer unplugged and contact Halvard Home support.

articles.topic: the app not finding the device
articles.text:
# Tessa dishwasher not appearing in the app

If the app cannot find your Tessa dishwasher, check that the dishwasher is switched on and your phone is connected to your home Wi-Fi.

Try these steps:

1. Move your phone close to the dishwasher.
2. Turn on Bluetooth and allow any nearby-device or location permissions requested by the app.
3. Avoid using a guest Wi-Fi network, as it can stop devices communicating with each other.
4. Close the app completely, then reopen it and try adding the dishwasher again.
5. If it still does not appear, switch the dishwasher off at the mains for 30 seconds, then switch it back on.

Still having trouble? Contact Halvard Home support and explain which steps you have tried.

Water leaking underneath your Vale fridge freezer

Water beneath your Vale fridge freezer can come from a spill, a blocked defrost drain or a door that is not closing properly.

Before checking, switch off the appliance and unplug it, provided the plug and surrounding area are dry. If they are wet, isolate the power at the fuse box instead.

Wipe up the water, then check that food packaging is not stopping either door from closing. Clean the door seals with a soft, damp cloth.

If you can see a drain hole inside the fridge, gently remove any loose debris around it. Do not insert sharp objects or remove panels.

If water returns after restarting, contact Halvard Home support for help.

Strange noises from your Keel washing machine

A rattling or banging noise can come from loose objects, an uneven load or a machine that is not level.

Pause the programme and wait until the drum has stopped and the door unlocks. Never force the door open. Spread heavy items evenly around the drum, then check for coins, keys or other loose objects.

If the machine rocks when gently pressed at a corner, switch it off and unplug it before adjusting its feet.

For a newly installed machine, check the installation guide to confirm that the transit bolts have been removed.

Stop using the machine if you hear grinding or notice a burning smell or leaking water. Switch it off and contact Halvard Home support.

Resetting your Orrin heat pump

A factory reset returns your Orrin heat pump’s user settings to their original values. It removes saved heating schedules and temperature preferences, so note these down before you begin.

To reset:
1. Make sure the heat pump is switched on and not displaying a warning.
2. On the controller, open **Settings**.
3. Select **System**, then **Factory reset**.
4. Choose **Confirm** to start the reset.
5. Leave the power connected while the controller restarts.

When the home screen returns, check the date and time, then enter your preferred temperatures and heating schedule again.

If **Factory reset** is unavailable, or the controller does not restart, contact Halvard Home support. Do not open the unit or change installer settings to force a reset.

Recycling your old Corra induction hob

Your old Halvard Home Corra induction hob should be recycled as electrical equipment, not placed in your household rubbish bin.

Before removal, switch off the hob’s electricity supply at the consumer unit. If the hob is wired directly into your home’s electrical circuit, arrange for a qualified electrician to disconnect it. Do not cut or pull out the wiring yourself.

Contact your local council to find a household waste recycling centre that accepts electric hobs. Check whether you need to book a visit and whether help with unloading is available.

If you are buying a replacement, ask the retailer whether it offers an old-appliance collection service. Confirm any charges and disconnection requirements before booking.

Brio kettle: using the child lock

The child lock stops the Brio kettle from starting a heating cycle when its controls are pressed accidentally. It does not lock the lid or make hot water safe to handle.

To switch the child lock on, make sure the kettle is not heating, then press and hold the lock button for three seconds. The lock indicator lights up to confirm that the controls are locked.

To unlock the kettle, press and hold the same button for three seconds, until the indicator goes out. You can then use the heating controls normally.

Always keep the kettle and its cable out of children’s reach. The child lock is not a substitute for adult supervision.

Updating your Vale’s firmware

Keep your Vale fridge freezer’s firmware up to date to receive the latest software improvements.

Before you start, make sure the appliance is connected to your home Wi-Fi and has a steady power supply. On the control panel, open **Settings**, select **Software update**, then choose **Check for updates**. If an update is available, follow the on-screen instructions to install it.

Leave the fridge freezer switched on throughout the update. Do not unplug it or restart it while installation is in progress. Keep the doors closed as much as possible to help maintain the temperature inside.

Wait for the control panel to confirm completion. If the update fails, check your Wi-Fi connection before trying again.

Resetting your Brio kettle

A factory reset returns your Brio kettle’s saved settings to their original values. Use it if you want to clear your preferences and start again.

Before you begin, make sure the kettle has finished boiling and cooled down. Do not attempt a reset while it is heating.

1. Place the kettle securely on its base.
2. Plug the base into a wall socket and switch the socket on.
3. Press and hold the power button for 10 seconds.
4. Release the button when the indicator light flashes twice. This confirms that the reset is complete.

You can now choose your preferred settings again. If the light does not flash, check that the kettle is seated correctly, then repeat the steps.

Frost or condensation on your Keel washing machine

Condensation forms when warm, moist air meets a cold surface. If your Keel washing machine feels damp on the outside, wipe it with a soft, dry cloth and improve ventilation in the room. Check nearby hoses and connections: recurring puddles may indicate a leak rather than condensation.

If you notice frost, stop using the machine. Switch it off and unplug it with dry hands, provided the plug and socket are dry. Allow the room and machine to warm naturally before use. Do not use boiling water, a hairdryer or a portable heater to speed up thawing.

Once thawed, check for visible leaks. If frost returns or you find damaged hoses, contact Halvard Home support before running another wash.

Cleaning your Brio kettle filter

Clean the filter regularly to remove loose limescale and keep water flowing freely.

1. Unplug your Brio kettle and let it cool completely before cleaning.
2. Empty the kettle, open the lid and gently remove the filter from behind the spout. Do not force it if it feels stuck.
3. Rinse the filter under warm running water. Use a soft brush to loosen any deposits.
4. For stubborn build-up, soak the filter in warm water for 10 minutes, then brush gently and rinse thoroughly.
5. Refit the filter securely before using the kettle again.

Avoid abrasive cleaners or metal brushes, which may damage the mesh. Never immerse the kettle body, base or plug in water.

Resetting your Corra induction hob

A factory reset restores your Corra induction hob’s original settings and clears saved preferences. Make a note of any settings you want to use again afterwards.

Before starting, remove all cookware and allow the cooking zones to cool. The control panel must be clean and dry.

1. Switch the hob off using the power button, but leave its electrical supply connected.
2. Press and hold the timer button and the minus button together for five seconds.
3. Release both buttons when you hear a beep.
4. Press the power button once to confirm the reset.

Switch the hob on again and set your preferences.

If the controls do not respond or the reset does not complete, contact Halvard Home support. Do not remove the hob or open its casing.

articles.topic: the app not finding the device
articles.text:
Corra induction hob not appearing in the app

If the app cannot find your Corra induction hob, first check that the hob has power and your phone is close to it.

Try these steps:

1. Turn on Bluetooth and Wi-Fi on your phone.
2. In your phone’s settings, allow the app to access Bluetooth and nearby devices. Allow local network access if prompted.
3. Close the app completely, wait 30 seconds, then open it again.
4. Follow the app’s instructions to put the hob into pairing mode, then search again.

If the hob was previously connected, check whether it already appears under another account or home in the app.

Still having trouble? Contact Halvard Home support with your phone model and a description of where setup stops.

# Tessa dishwasher child lock

The child lock on your Halvard Home Tessa dishwasher helps prevent accidental changes to the controls.

To switch it on, press and hold the button marked with a padlock for three seconds. The padlock light comes on to confirm that the controls are locked. If a wash is already running, it continues with the selected settings.

To switch the child lock off, press and hold the same button for three seconds. Wait for the padlock light to go out before choosing a programme or changing a setting.

The child lock does not physically lock the door. Keep children away from the dishwasher during use, as opening the door can release hot steam. Store dishwasher detergent out of their reach.

Saving energy on your Corra induction hob

Choose the lowest power setting that keeps your food cooking as needed. Once water reaches the boil, turn the power down until it maintains a gentle simmer, rather than leaving the zone on high.

To reduce energy use:
- Keep a lid on saucepans where the recipe allows. This holds in heat, so you can use a lower setting.
- Use an induction-compatible pan with a flat base that matches the cooking zone.
- Heat only the amount of water you need.
- Avoid heating empty pans or preheating longer than your recipe requires.
- Switch each zone off as soon as cooking is finished.

If cooking slows too much, increase the power gradually rather than immediately selecting the highest setting.

Unusual vibration from your Orrin heat pump

A new or unusually strong vibration can come from an object touching the unit, loose mounting points or an uneven base.

Switch the heat pump off using its normal controls before checking around it. Remove any loose items leaning against the casing, and check for leaves or debris around the outdoor unit. Do not remove covers, reach through the grille or adjust mounting bolts yourself.

If the area is clear and there is no visible damage, restart the heat pump and listen from a safe distance. If the vibration continues, switch it off and contact Halvard Home support or a qualified installer.

Keep the unit switched off if it shakes violently, moves on its base or makes a grinding noise.

Unusual vibration from your Lumen smart thermostat

An unusual vibration may come from a loose wall fixing or nearby heating equipment rather than the thermostat itself.

If the heating is running, switch it off using the thermostat’s controls and wait five minutes. Check whether the vibration stops. This helps establish whether it is linked to the heating system.

Look for a visible gap between the thermostat and the wall, but do not pull the unit away, open its casing or tighten hidden fixings yourself.

If the vibration continues, contact Halvard Home support. Tell us when it happens, whether the heating is running and whether you can hear buzzing.

If you notice excessive heat, smoke or a burning smell, stop using the thermostat and seek urgent professional assistance.

Installing your Fenwick cooker hood

Before starting, switch off the electricity supply at the consumer unit. Keep it off until the hood is securely fitted and all electrical work is complete.

Check the installation guide supplied with your hood for the required clearance above your hob. Do not guess this distance: it depends on the hob type and installation requirements.

Use wall fixings suitable for your wall, and check for hidden pipes and cables before drilling. Arrange for a qualified electrician to make any fixed electrical connection.

If using ducted extraction, follow the guide’s instructions for routing the outlet outdoors. Once installation is complete, remove packaging, check that the filters are seated correctly, then test the fan and light.

Mira robot vacuum warranty

The Halvard Home Mira robot vacuum comes with a two-year warranty from the date of purchase. Keep your receipt or order confirmation, as you will need it to show when you bought your vacuum.

The warranty covers faults caused by defects in materials or workmanship during normal household use. It does not cover accidental damage, misuse or normal wear, such as brushes wearing down through regular cleaning.

If your Mira develops a fault within the warranty period, contact Halvard Home customer support with your proof of purchase and a short description of the problem. Avoid attempting repairs yourself before seeking advice.

Your warranty does not affect your statutory rights.

Using delay start on your Keel washing machine

Delay start lets you choose when your wash begins. A delay of 3 hours means the machine waits 3 hours before starting; it does not mean the wash will finish in 3 hours.

To set a delay, load the drum, add detergent and close the door firmly. Select your wash programme, then press Delay Start until the display shows the waiting time you want. Press Start to begin the countdown.

To wash straight away, cancel the delay by setting it to zero before pressing Start.

If the machine appears to be doing nothing, check whether a delay is active. During the countdown, the drum can remain still. This is normal and does not mean the machine has stopped working.

Replacing a Keel door seal

A damaged door seal can let water leak from the front of your Halvard Home Keel washing machine. Check the rubber seal for splits, holes or areas that have pulled away from the door opening.

Before inspecting it, switch the machine off, unplug it and turn off the water supply. Do not use the machine if the seal is torn or leaking.

To request a replacement, contact Halvard Home support with your machine’s model details and a clear photo of the damage. Ask them to confirm that the replacement seal fits your machine before ordering.

Arrange fitting with a qualified repair technician. A poorly fitted seal can leak, even if the replacement itself is undamaged.

Updating your Keel washing machine firmware

Firmware updates help keep your Keel washing machine working smoothly. Before starting, finish any wash programme, empty the drum and leave the machine switched on.

Make sure your washing machine is connected to your home Wi-Fi. Open the Halvard Home app, select your Keel washing machine, then choose **Settings > Firmware update**. If an update is available, tap **Install** and follow the instructions.

Do not switch off the machine, unplug it or restart your router while the update is running. You cannot start a wash during installation.

Wait until the app confirms that the update is complete before using the machine. If installation fails, check your Wi-Fi connection and try again. Contact Halvard Home support if it still fails.

Pair your Keel with a voice assistant

To pair your Keel washing machine with a voice assistant, first add it to the Halvard Home app and check that it appears online.

1. Open your voice assistant’s app on your phone.
2. Find the section for adding devices, skills or services.
3. Search for Halvard Home and select it.
4. Sign in with the same Halvard Home account you use for your washing machine.
5. Allow account linking, then ask the assistant to discover devices.

Give the machine a simple name, such as “Washing machine”, so the assistant can recognise it easily.

If pairing fails, check your internet connection and confirm that the machine is still online in the Halvard Home app before trying again.

articles.topic: the app not finding the device
articles.text:
App cannot find your Fenwick cooker hood

If the app cannot find your Fenwick cooker hood, try these steps:

1. Check that the hood has power and your phone is connected to your home Wi-Fi, rather than mobile data.
2. Move your phone within one metre of the hood while setting it up.
3. Turn the hood off at its wall switch for 30 seconds, then switch it back on.
4. Enable Bluetooth on your phone and allow any nearby-device or local-network permissions requested by the app.
5. Put the hood into pairing mode using the instructions in its user guide, then try adding it again.

If it still does not appear, restart your phone and router. Contact Halvard Home support if the problem continues.

articles.topic: the app not finding the device
articles.text:
Mira robot vacuum not found in the app

If the Halvard Home app cannot find your Mira robot vacuum, check that the vacuum is switched on and placed near your router.

Connect your phone to a 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network before starting setup. A 5 GHz-only connection will not work for pairing. If your router shows separate network names, choose the one marked 2.4 GHz.

Turn on Bluetooth on your phone and allow the app access to nearby devices when prompted. Close and reopen the app, then try adding the vacuum again.

If it still does not appear, restart your phone and router, then repeat setup. Avoid a factory reset unless Halvard Home support advises it. Contact support if these checks do not help.

articles.topic: the app not finding the device
articles.text:
Vale fridge freezer not found in the app

If the app cannot find your Vale fridge freezer, try these checks:

- Check that the fridge freezer is switched on and your phone is connected to your home Wi-Fi.
- Move your phone closer to the appliance during setup.
- Turn on Bluetooth and allow any nearby device or local network permissions requested by the app.
- Follow the pairing instructions in the guide supplied with your fridge freezer.
- Fully close the app, wait 10 seconds, then reopen it and try adding the appliance again.

If it still does not appear, check for an app update. Contact Halvard Home support if the problem continues, and tell them which steps you have tried.

Burning smell from your Lumen smart thermostat

A burning smell is not normal. Stop using your Lumen smart thermostat and switch off the power to your heating system at its mains isolator, but only if you can reach it safely. Turning the temperature down does not disconnect the electrical supply.

Do not touch the thermostat if it feels hot, looks scorched or is making crackling sounds. Do not remove its cover, attempt repairs or turn the power back on to test it.

If you see smoke or flames, leave the property and call 999. Do not use water on electrical equipment.

Keep the system switched off until a qualified electrician has checked it. Contact Halvard Home support for advice about the thermostat once any immediate danger has been dealt with.

Ordering a spare accessory

To order a spare accessory for your Lumen smart thermostat, contact Halvard Home customer support with the name or a clear description of the item you need.

Before you get in touch, check the model name on your thermostat and take a photo of the accessory, if you still have it. This helps the support team identify a suitable replacement.

Ask the team to confirm compatibility, price, delivery charges and availability before you place your order. Include your delivery country so they can check the options for your location.

If you are unsure what the accessory is called, explain what it does and where it fits. Do not send payment card details by email.

Booking a Lumen engineer visit

To request an engineer visit for your Lumen smart thermostat, contact Halvard Home customer support. Provide your name, installation address, contact number and a short description of the problem.

Before contacting support, check whether the thermostat display is on and note whether your heating responds when you change the target temperature. Share these observations so the team can assess the issue.

Tell support which days you are available and mention any access requirements. Ask about call-out charges and warranty cover before agreeing to the visit.

Your appointment is only confirmed once support gives you a date and arrival window. On the day, keep the thermostat accessible and arrange for an adult to be at home.

Descaling your Keel washing machine

Limescale can build up inside your Halvard Home Keel washing machine, especially in hard water areas. Use a descaler labelled as suitable for washing machines, and follow its instructions for the amount and treatment frequency.

1. Remove all laundry before descaling.
2. Add the descaler where its label directs. Do not add detergent or fabric conditioner.
3. Run the empty machine on the cycle and temperature specified by the descaler instructions, provided these are permitted in your machine’s care guide.
4. Once the cycle finishes, wipe the door seal with a damp cloth.

Never mix descaler with bleach or other cleaning products. If deposits remain, check the descaler instructions before repeating the treatment.

Ashby tumble dryer warranty

Your Halvard Home Ashby tumble dryer comes with a two-year warranty from the date of purchase. Keep your receipt or order confirmation, as you will need it to show when you bought the appliance.

The warranty covers faults caused by defective materials or workmanship during normal household use. It does not cover accidental damage, misuse or ordinary wear and tear.

If your dryer develops a fault within the warranty period, contact Halvard Home customer support before arranging a repair. Have your proof of purchase ready and describe what is happening. The support team will explain the next steps and confirm whether the repair is covered.

Your warranty does not affect your statutory rights.

Pairing your Corra hob with a voice assistant

Pair your Corra induction hob in the Halvard Home app before linking it to your voice assistant.

1. Connect your phone to your home Wi-Fi and open the Halvard Home app.
2. Select **Add appliance**, choose your hob and follow the pairing instructions.
3. Open your voice assistant’s app and find its device or service linking menu.
4. Search for **Halvard Home**, then sign in with the same account you used to register the hob.
5. Allow the assistant to discover devices, then give the hob a simple name, such as “Kitchen hob”.

If the hob does not appear, check that it is online in the Halvard Home app, then repeat device discovery.

Tessa dishwasher display stays blank

If your Tessa dishwasher’s display stays blank, start by checking its power supply.

Make sure your hands are dry, then check that the plug is fully inserted and the wall socket is switched on. If the plug is behind the dishwasher, do not pull the appliance out to reach it.

Switch the dishwasher off at an accessible wall socket for 60 seconds, then switch it back on and press the power button.

If the display is still blank, check whether other appliances have also lost power. A tripped circuit breaker can interrupt the dishwasher’s supply.

If power is available but the display remains blank, contact Halvard Home support. Do not remove any panels or attempt internal electrical repairs.

# Installing your Lumen smart thermostat

Before you begin, check the supplied installation guide to confirm that your Lumen smart thermostat is compatible with your heating system. If you are unsure, ask a qualified heating installer before removing your existing thermostat.

Choose an internal wall around 1.5 metres above the floor, away from radiators, direct sunlight and draughts. This helps the thermostat measure the room temperature accurately.

Switch off the heating system’s electricity supply before any wiring work. Have a qualified installer connect the thermostat according to the supplied wiring instructions; do not guess wire connections from their colours.

Once installation is complete, restore power and follow the on-screen setup instructions. Set your preferred temperature, then check that the heating responds. Keep the installation guide for future reference.

# Frost or condensation on your Mira

Frost or condensation can form when your Mira robot vacuum moves from a cold space into a warm, humid room.

If you notice moisture, switch the vacuum off and unplug its charging dock, provided the plug and socket are dry. Do not charge or run the vacuum while it is damp.

Wipe the outside with a soft, dry cloth. Leave the vacuum and dock in a dry room for at least 24 hours, and longer if any moisture remains. Do not use a hairdryer, radiator or direct heat to speed up drying.

To help prevent build-up, store Mira indoors away from cold draughts. If moisture appears inside the vacuum or keeps returning, contact Halvard Home support before using it again.

Strange noises from your Tessa dishwasher

A gentle hum or occasional gurgle during use can be normal. A new rattling, scraping or banging sound is worth checking.

Pause the programme and wait for spraying to stop before opening the door carefully, keeping clear of hot steam. Switch the dishwasher off before checking inside.

Check that plates and utensils are secure. A utensil hanging below the lower basket can catch the spray arm and cause a repeated knocking sound. Move anything sticking through the basket, then gently turn the spray arm by hand to check that it moves freely.

Close the door and restart the programme. If the noise continues, or you hear loud grinding, stop using the dishwasher and contact Halvard Home support.

Using the Vale child lock

The child lock on your Halvard Home Vale fridge freezer prevents accidental changes to the temperature and other control panel settings. It does not lock the doors.

To switch the child lock on, press and hold the lock button for three seconds. A lock symbol on the display shows that it is active.

To unlock the controls, press and hold the same button for three seconds again. Wait for the lock symbol to disappear before changing a setting.

If the controls do not respond, check whether the lock symbol is still showing. Make sure your finger and the control panel are clean and dry, then try again.

Keep children supervised around the appliance, even when the child lock is on.

articles.topic: the door or lid not closing
articles.text:
Brio kettle lid not closing

If the lid on your Halvard Home Brio kettle will not close, switch the kettle off, unplug the base and let the kettle cool completely before checking it.

Empty the kettle, then look around the rim and underside of the lid for limescale or trapped debris. Wipe these areas with a soft, damp cloth. Do not immerse the kettle or base in water.

Check that nothing is blocking the hinge or catch, then gently lower the lid into place. Do not force it shut or try to bend the catch.

Do not use the kettle while the lid will not close securely. If cleaning does not help, contact Halvard Home support for advice.

Replacing a Lumen thermostat wall plate

If your Lumen smart thermostat’s wall plate is cracked or no longer holds the thermostat securely, ask Halvard Home support for a compatible replacement. Do not glue a damaged plate back together or force the thermostat onto it.

Include two photos with your request: one showing the thermostat and one showing the damage. Only photograph damage you can see without removing covers or exposing wiring. This helps support identify the replacement you need.

Before any removal work, switch off power to the heating system at the consumer unit. If replacing the plate involves disconnecting wires, use a qualified installer.

Keep the thermostat somewhere dry while it is detached, and follow the fitting instructions supplied with the replacement.

Lumen thermostat responding slowly

If your Lumen smart thermostat responds slowly or your home feels slow to warm up, check whether the delay affects the thermostat, the app or the heating itself.

For a simple heating check, set the target temperature 2°C above the room temperature shown on the display. Make sure heating is enabled and that a schedule has not lowered the target.

If changes made in the app take time to appear, check that your home Wi-Fi is working. Try adjusting the temperature directly on the thermostat to help identify a connection issue.

Keep furniture and curtains clear of the thermostat so air can circulate around it.

If the thermostat responds but the heating remains weak, contact your heating engineer. For persistent control delays, contact Halvard Home support.

Saving energy with your Keel washing machine

Choose a 30°C wash for lightly soiled everyday clothes, provided their care labels allow it. Lower wash temperatures reduce the energy needed to heat the water.

If your Keel has an Eco programme, use it for suitable loads. It may take longer than a standard cycle, but a longer running time does not necessarily mean higher energy use.

For better results with less waste:

- Wash a full load where possible, without exceeding the programme’s load limit.
- Avoid prewash unless clothes are heavily soiled.
- Measure detergent according to the pack instructions and your water hardness.
- Select a higher spin speed, if fabric labels allow, to reduce drying time afterwards.

Check your model’s manual for available programmes and load limits.

Burning smell from your Mira robot vacuum
