If your Mira robot vacuum smells of burning, stop cleaning immediately. Switch off the vacuum and unplug its charging dock from the wall socket, if it is safe to do so. Do not charge or run it again until the cause has been checked.

Once the vacuum is completely cool, check the brush and wheels for trapped hair, thread or debris. Remove only loose material you can reach without opening the casing. A jammed brush can put extra strain on the motor.

Do not use water, dismantle the battery or touch melted areas. Contact Halvard Home support before using the vacuum again. If there is smoke or fire, move away and call the fire service.

Recycling your old Tessa dishwasher

Recycle your old Tessa dishwasher through an electrical appliance recycling service, rather than putting it in your household rubbish.

Before disconnecting it, switch it off at the mains, unplug it and close the water supply valve. If it is wired directly into the electrical supply, ask a qualified electrician to disconnect it.

Empty the dishwasher and drain any remaining water from the hoses into a shallow container. Keep the appliance upright when moving it, and get help: dishwashers are heavy.

Ask your local council where you can take large electrical appliances or whether it offers a collection service. If you are buying a replacement, ask the retailer about taking away the old unit. Confirm any charges and disconnection requirements before booking.

Recycling your old Vale fridge freezer

Your old Vale fridge freezer should be recycled through an authorised electrical waste service, not placed in a household rubbish bin.

Before collection, remove all food and unplug the unit from the wall socket. Let any ice melt naturally, then wipe the inside dry. Put towels around the base to catch water, and never use sharp tools to remove ice.

Contact your local council to ask about fridge freezer collections or an approved recycling centre. If you are buying a replacement, ask the retailer whether it offers an old-appliance collection service and whether charges apply.

Do not cut pipes or damage the cooling system: refrigerant needs specialist handling. Keep children away from the unit while it awaits collection.

Tessa dishwasher running slowly or cleaning poorly

If your Tessa dishwasher takes longer than expected or leaves dishes dirty, start with these checks.

Switch off and unplug the dishwasher before cleaning. Remove food scraps from the filter and rinse it under running water. A blocked filter can restrict water flow and reduce cleaning performance. Refit it securely before using the machine.

Check that dishes do not block the spray arms. Turn each arm gently by hand to make sure it moves freely. Avoid stacking items tightly together.

Use dishwasher detergent and choose a programme suited to the load. Economy programmes can take longer than standard washes.

If performance stays poor after these checks, contact Halvard Home support. Stop using the dishwasher if it leaks.

Connecting your Ashby tumble dryer to wi-fi

Connect your Ashby tumble dryer to a 2.4 GHz home wi-fi network. Your phone should be connected to the same network during setup.

1. Switch on the dryer and open the Halvard Home app on your phone.
2. Sign in, then select **Add appliance** and choose **Tumble dryer**.
3. Follow the app’s instructions to put the dryer into pairing mode.
4. Select your home network and enter its wi-fi password. Passwords are case-sensitive.
5. Keep your phone near the dryer until the app confirms the connection.

If setup fails, check the password and make sure the wi-fi signal reaches the dryer. Restart the app and try again. Avoid using a guest network that requires signing in through a web page.

Resetting your Fenwick cooker hood

A factory reset returns your Fenwick cooker hood’s controls to their original settings and clears your saved preferences.

Before you begin, finish cooking and allow the hob to cool. Leave the hood connected to the electricity supply, but switch off its fan and light.

1. Press and hold the fan and light buttons together for 10 seconds.
2. Release both buttons when the control lights flash twice. This confirms that the reset is complete.
3. Wait until the lights stop flashing, then switch on the fan to check that the controls respond.

You can now choose your preferred fan speed and lighting again. If the control lights do not flash, contact Halvard Home support for help.

# Keel washing machine: power cut during use

If your Halvard Home Keel washing machine stops during a power cut, switch it off at the wall socket if you can reach it safely with dry hands. Leave the door closed and do not force it open, as water may remain inside.

When power returns:

1. Switch the wall socket back on.
2. Check whether the machine is ready to continue the interrupted wash.
3. If it does not continue, select a suitable wash programme and start it again.

If you need to remove the laundry, run a drain programme first. Wait until the drum has stopped and the door lock releases before opening the door.

If the machine remains unresponsive, contact Halvard Home support.

Keel washing machine: flashing warning light

A flashing warning light on your Halvard Home Keel washing machine means it needs attention. Check which light is flashing before trying these steps.

If the drum is still moving, let it stop. Do not force the door open. Check that the door is firmly closed and that no clothing is trapped around the seal.

If the warning continues, switch the machine off and unplug it for 5 minutes. With the power disconnected, check that the water supply tap is open and the inlet hose is not kinked.

Reconnect the power and try starting the programme again. If the light keeps flashing, contact Halvard Home support. Tell them which light flashes and when it started.

Installing your Tessa dishwasher

Before installing your Halvard Home Tessa dishwasher, remove all packaging and check for transport damage. Do not connect the appliance if it is damaged.

Switch off the electricity and turn off the water supply before connecting anything. Follow the supplied installation guide when attaching the inlet and drain hoses. Make sure neither hose is kinked or trapped behind the dishwasher.

Adjust the feet until the dishwasher is level and stable. Connect it to an earthed socket; do not use an extension lead. If plumbing or electrical work is needed, use a qualified professional.

Turn the water supply back on and check the connections for leaks. Before loading dishes, run one empty wash cycle, following the installation guide’s first-use instructions.

Booking an engineer for your Mira robot vacuum

Contact Halvard Home customer support to request an engineer visit for your Mira robot vacuum. Explain what is happening, when the problem started and any checks you have already tried.

Have your address, contact details and proof of purchase ready. Let the team know your preferred appointment dates and mention any access requirements, such as stairs or parking restrictions.

Before agreeing to a booking, ask whether a call-out charge applies and what the visit will cover. Request confirmation of the appointment date and arrival window.

Before the engineer examines your Mira, switch it off and unplug its charging dock. Keep both accessible, and clear enough floor space for the engineer to check the vacuum safely.

Replacing a Vale freezer drawer

If a freezer drawer in your Halvard Home Vale fridge freezer is cracked or no longer slides properly, check which drawer needs replacing before ordering.

Empty the damaged drawer before removing it. Do not force it past a stop or pull on cracked plastic, as sharp edges could cause injury. Follow the removal instructions in your appliance manual.

Find the appliance’s model details on its rating label and use them to check that the replacement drawer will fit. Include the drawer’s position when asking for help, as upper and lower drawers may differ.

Once fitted, check that the new drawer slides freely and that the freezer door closes fully before putting food back inside.

Booking a Fenwick cooker hood engineer visit

To arrange an engineer visit for your Fenwick cooker hood, contact Halvard Home customer support and explain what is wrong. Before getting in touch, write down when the problem started and whether it happens every time you use the hood.

Have your address, contact number and any purchase or warranty details ready. Tell the adviser if the hood is difficult to reach or if there are any access restrictions at your property.

Ask the adviser to confirm the appointment date, any call-out charge and what the visit includes before agreeing to the booking.

On the day, clear the hob and surrounding worktop so the engineer can reach the hood safely. Leave any inspection or dismantling to the engineer.

Resetting your Tessa dishwasher

A factory reset returns your Halvard Home Tessa dishwasher’s saved settings to their original values. Use it if you want to clear your preferences and set the appliance up again.

Before starting, let any wash programme finish and empty the dishwasher.

1. Switch the dishwasher on, but do not start a programme.
2. Press and hold the Programme and Start buttons together for five seconds, until the indicator lights flash.
3. Release both buttons, then switch the dishwasher off.
4. Wait 30 seconds before switching it back on.

The reset clears your saved wash preferences. Afterwards, check the water hardness and rinse aid settings and adjust them for your household.

If the lights do not flash, contact Halvard Home support for help.

Brio kettle: frost or condensation

Condensation forms when warm steam meets a cooler surface. Small droplets around your Brio kettle’s lid after boiling can be normal.

Before cleaning, unplug the kettle and let it cool. Wipe the outside with a soft, dry cloth. Never immerse the kettle or its power base in water.

If frost appears after storage in a freezing location, leave the kettle unplugged in a dry room until all ice has melted and the kettle and base are completely dry. Do not use the kettle’s heating function to thaw it.

To reduce condensation, keep the kettle in a ventilated indoor space and avoid filling above the maximum mark.

If water repeatedly collects underneath, stop using the kettle and contact Halvard Home support.

Recycling your old Ashby tumble dryer

Your old Halvard Home Ashby tumble dryer should be recycled as electrical waste, not placed in your household rubbish bin.

Before collection or transport, switch it off at the wall and unplug it. Allow it to cool completely, then empty the water container if your model has one. Remove any laundry and secure the power cable so it cannot trail during handling.

Contact your local council to find a recycling centre that accepts tumble dryers or to arrange a bulky electrical waste collection. Check booking requirements and any charges before travelling.

If you are buying a replacement, ask the retailer whether it offers collection and recycling of your old appliance. Do not attempt to lift or move the dryer alone.

Brio kettle not switching on

If your Halvard Home Brio kettle will not switch on, try these checks:

1. Check that the plug is fully inserted and the wall socket is switched on. Test the socket with another appliance you know works.
2. Unplug the kettle before checking the base. Make sure the base and the underside of the kettle are dry, then place the kettle firmly on its base.
3. Check the water level. Fill between the minimum and maximum marks before trying again.
4. If the kettle recently boiled dry, unplug it and allow it to cool fully before refilling.

Stop using the kettle if the cable, plug or base looks damaged. If these checks do not help, contact Halvard Home support.

Removing limescale from your Corra induction hob

Your Corra induction hob does not need internal descaling. Limescale marks on the glass are mineral deposits left behind when water dries.

Switch the hob off and let the surface cool completely before cleaning. Wipe away loose dirt with a soft cloth dampened with warm water and a little washing-up liquid.

For stubborn white marks, use a cleaner labelled as suitable for induction hob glass, following its instructions. Apply it to a cloth rather than pouring it onto the hob. Wipe away any residue with a clean, damp cloth, then dry with a soft towel.

Do not use kettle descaler, abrasive powders or metal scourers. Avoid letting liquid enter the hob’s edges or controls.

Replacing the glass on your Corra induction hob

If the glass surface of your Corra induction hob is cracked or chipped, stop using it. Switch off the hob’s electricity supply at the consumer unit before touching or cleaning the surface.

Contact Halvard Home support to ask about a replacement glass surface. Have the hob’s model details, proof of purchase and a clear photo of the damage ready. Check your user guide or purchase documents for the model details; do not lift the hob out to find them.

Ask support to confirm which replacement is compatible with your hob and whether fitting is included in the quote. A qualified technician should carry out the replacement. Do not try to repair cracked glass with glue or sealant.

# Ashby tumble dryer: unusual vibration

If your Ashby tumble dryer vibrates more than usual, stop the programme and wait until the drum has stopped. Switch it off and unplug it before checking the appliance.

Check that the dryer stands firmly on a hard, level floor. All four feet should touch the floor, and the cabinet should not rock when gently pressed at opposite corners. Adjust the feet if needed.

Make sure the dryer is not touching nearby cupboards or other appliances. Remove anything resting on top.

An uneven load can also cause vibration. Untangle bulky items and spread them loosely around the drum before restarting.

If the vibration continues, or you hear scraping or banging, stop using the dryer and contact Halvard Home support.

articles.topic: the door or lid not closing
articles.text:
Lumen thermostat lid will not close

If the lid on your Lumen smart thermostat will not close, do not force it. Switch off power to your heating system at its isolation switch before checking the thermostat.

Look around the lid’s edges for dust, packaging or anything trapped in the gap. Wipe accessible edges with a dry, soft cloth. Do not touch wiring or use water inside the thermostat.

Check that the lid sits straight against the casing, then press gently along its edges. Stop if it needs firm pressure or springs open again.

If the lid or casing looks cracked, bent or loose, leave it alone and contact Halvard Home support. Do not use tape or glue to hold it shut.

articles.topic: the door or lid not closing
articles.text:
Fenwick cooker hood door or lid not closing

If your Fenwick cooker hood door or lid will not close, switch the hood off at the mains and let it cool before checking it.

Look for grease build-up or trapped objects around the closing edge. Wipe accessible edges with a soft cloth dampened with warm, soapy water, then dry them.

Check that the grease filter sits fully in its holder. A filter sticking out of position can obstruct the cover and prevent it from closing.

Try closing the door or lid gently. Do not force it, bend the hinges or adjust the latch with tools.

If it still will not close, leave the hood switched off and contact Halvard Home support.

Cleaning your Corra hob filter

Switch off your Corra induction hob and its extractor, then let everything cool before cleaning the filter.

Remove the filter as shown in your user manual. Avoid forcing it if it does not lift out easily. Wash it in warm water with a little washing-up liquid, using a soft brush to loosen grease. Rinse thoroughly with clean water.

Do not use abrasive pads, oven cleaner or sharp tools, as these can damage the filter. Let it dry completely before refitting it, and check that it sits securely in place.

Wipe the surrounding accessible area with a soft, damp cloth. Never pour water into the extractor opening. If the filter is damaged or will not fit securely, contact Halvard Home support.

Orrin heat pump not switching on

If your Orrin heat pump will not switch on, start with these checks:

- Check that the wall controller is on and its display is lit. If it uses batteries, replace them if the display is blank.
- Select heating mode and set the target temperature 2°C above the current room temperature.
- Check whether a timer or holiday setting is preventing heating.
- Make sure the heat pump’s power switch is on, provided it is safe to access.

After changing the settings, wait five minutes before checking again. Avoid repeatedly switching the power off and on.

If the unit still does not start, contact Halvard Home support. Do not remove covers or touch wiring. If you notice smoke or a burning smell, keep away and seek urgent assistance.

Ordering a spare accessory

To order a spare accessory for your Halvard Home Tessa dishwasher, first identify what you need, such as a cutlery basket or cup holder.

Take one clear photograph of the existing accessory, including any damaged area. If the accessory is missing, photograph the space where it should fit instead.

Contact Halvard Home customer support with the product name, a description of the accessory and your photograph. Ask them to confirm compatibility with your dishwasher before you place an order.

Request the total price, including delivery, and the estimated delivery time. Keep your order confirmation until the accessory arrives.

Before fitting the replacement, check that it matches your order and follow any supplied instructions.

Updating your Corra induction hob

Keep your Corra induction hob up to date using the Halvard Home app. Before starting, switch off all cooking zones, remove any pans and let the surface cool. Leave the hob connected to its electrical supply.

1. Open the Halvard Home app and select your Corra hob.
2. Go to **Settings**, then **Firmware update**.
3. If an update is available, tap **Install** and follow the instructions shown.

Do not use the hob or switch off its power while the update is running. Wait until the app confirms that installation is complete before cooking again.

If the update does not start, check that your phone and hob are connected to Wi-Fi, then try again. Contact Halvard Home support if the problem continues.

Power cut during use

If your Vale fridge freezer loses power, keep both doors closed to help food stay cold. Note when the power cut started.

A full freezer can usually keep food frozen for around 48 hours with the door shut; a half-full freezer can manage around 24 hours. These are estimates, so check food carefully afterwards.

When power returns, check that the appliance has power and starts cooling. Avoid adding fresh food until the fridge is at 5°C or below and the freezer is at −18°C.

Discard perishable chilled food if it has been above 8°C for more than four hours. Never taste food to judge whether it is safe. If you are unsure how warm it became, discard it.

Lumen smart thermostat: power cut during use

A power cut can interrupt your Lumen smart thermostat’s control of your heating. If the display goes blank, leave the thermostat in place and check whether other electrical appliances have also lost power.

Once power returns, allow 5 minutes before checking the thermostat. If it switches on, check the displayed time, target temperature and heating schedule, and correct anything that has changed.

If the thermostat appears offline in the app, check that your router has restarted and your home Wi-Fi is working.

Avoid a factory reset as your first troubleshooting step, as this may erase your settings. If the display remains blank after household power is restored, contact Halvard Home support. Do not open the thermostat or touch its wiring.

Booking an engineer for your Brio kettle

To arrange an engineer visit for your Brio kettle, contact Halvard Home customer support and explain what is happening. Have your name, address, contact number and proof of purchase ready, if available.

Describe the fault clearly, including when it started and whether it happens every time you use the kettle. Tell the team about any checks you have already tried.

Before confirming a booking, ask about available appointment times, any visit charge and whether your warranty covers the work.

Switch off and unplug the kettle before checking it for visible damage. If it leaks, sparks or has a damaged lead, stop using it. Do not remove the casing or attempt internal repairs while waiting for advice.

Using the Corra hob timer

The Corra induction hob’s cooking timer switches off the selected cooking zone when the set time ends. Set a separate timer for each zone you want to control.

Place a suitable pan on the hob, select the cooking zone and choose a heat level. Touch the timer control, then use the plus or minus controls to set the cooking time in minutes. For example, setting 10 minutes switches that zone off after 10 minutes.

To change the time, select the same zone and touch the timer control again. To cancel its timer, reduce the time to zero.

The timer does not replace supervision. Stay nearby while cooking, especially when heating oil or fat.

Mira robot vacuum: flashing warning light

A flashing warning light means your Mira robot vacuum needs attention. Start with these checks:

1. Switch the vacuum off and wait 30 seconds before inspecting it.
2. Remove and empty the dustbin, then fit it securely back into place.
3. Check the main brush and wheels for trapped hair, thread or other debris. Clear any blockages gently, without using sharp tools.
4. Wipe the sensors with a clean, dry cloth.
5. Place the vacuum on a clear, level area of floor, switch it on and try cleaning again.

If the light continues flashing, stop using the vacuum and contact Halvard Home support. Tell them when the flashing started and whether the vacuum still moves or charges.

articles.topic: using it in a holiday home
articles.text:
Using your Keel in a holiday home

A few simple checks can help keep your Keel washing machine ready for each visit.

On arrival, check the inlet and drain hoses for leaks or damage. Turn on the water supply before starting a wash. Choose a programme that matches the laundry’s care labels, and measure detergent for the load size and local water hardness.

Before leaving the property:
- Remove all laundry and check the drum.
- Wipe the door seal and remove any trapped items.
- Switch off the machine and turn off its water supply.
- Leave the door slightly open to help the drum dry, keeping children and pets away.

If the property may freeze while empty, arrange suitable frost protection before departure.

articles.topic: a fault code on the display
articles.text:
Brio kettle: fault message on the display

If your Brio kettle shows a fault message, stop using it and switch it off at the socket. Unplug it and leave it to cool for 15 minutes before checking it.

Check that the water level is between the minimum and maximum marks. Make sure the kettle sits flat on its base and that the base and electrical connections are dry. Never immerse the base in water.

Once these checks are complete, reconnect the kettle and try switching it on once. If the message returns, unplug it and contact Halvard Home support. Tell the adviser exactly what appears on the display.

Do not use the kettle if it leaks, smells burnt or has a damaged cable.

Pairing your Fenwick cooker hood with a voice assistant

Connect your Fenwick cooker hood to the Halvard Home app before linking it to your voice assistant. Use a 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network during setup.

1. Switch on the hood, then press and hold its Wi-Fi button for five seconds, until the indicator flashes.
2. Open the Halvard Home app, select **Add appliance** and follow the instructions.
3. In your voice assistant’s app, find Halvard Home under services or skills.
4. Enable the service and sign in with the same Halvard Home account.
5. Search for devices, then give the hood a simple name, such as “Kitchen hood”.

Try asking your assistant to switch on the kitchen hood. If it does not respond, check that the hood is online in the Halvard Home app.

Cleaning your heating or cooling filter

Your Lumen smart thermostat controls your heating or cooling system; the filter to clean is in that equipment, not the thermostat.

Before removing the filter, switch the system off at the thermostat, then isolate the equipment’s power supply. Check your equipment’s instructions for the filter’s location and how to remove it safely.

If the filter is reusable, gently vacuum away loose dust. Only rinse it if the equipment’s instructions allow this, and let it dry completely before refitting. Replace disposable filters rather than washing them.

Refit the filter in the direction shown by its airflow arrow, secure the cover and restore power. If airflow remains weak, contact your heating or cooling service provider.

Corra induction hob warranty

Your Halvard Home Corra induction hob comes with a two-year manufacturer’s warranty from the date of purchase. For example, if you bought your hob on 10 June 2026, its warranty runs until 10 June 2028.

The warranty covers faults caused by defective materials or workmanship during normal household use. It does not cover accidental damage, misuse or damage caused by incorrect installation.

Keep your receipt or order confirmation, as you will need proof of purchase when requesting a warranty repair. To make a claim, contact Halvard Home customer support with your purchase date and a brief description of the fault.

Your manufacturer’s warranty is in addition to your statutory rights and does not affect them.

Brio kettle: flashing warning light

A flashing warning light can mean the Brio kettle’s boil-dry protection has activated because there is too little water inside.

Switch the kettle off and unplug the base from the wall socket. Leave it to cool for at least 15 minutes before checking it. Do not touch the inside while it is hot.

Once cool, fill the kettle with fresh water between the minimum and maximum marks. Check that the lid is fully closed and the base and kettle underside are dry. Place the kettle securely on its base, reconnect the power and try again.

If the light keeps flashing, stop using the kettle and contact Halvard Home support. Do not open the base or attempt electrical repairs.

Tessa dishwasher: unusual vibration

An unusual vibration from your Halvard Home Tessa dishwasher can happen when dishes touch each other or a spray arm catches an item.

Pause the programme and wait for the spray to stop before opening the door slowly. Switch the dishwasher off before checking inside.

Check that plates, pans and cutlery are secure, with space between them. Turn each spray arm gently by hand: it should rotate freely without touching any dishes. Move anything that blocks it.

Check that the dishwasher stands firmly without rocking. Do not pull out a built-in appliance or remove its panels.

Restart the programme after adjusting the load. If strong vibration continues, stop using the dishwasher and contact Halvard Home support for advice.

Moving your Vale fridge freezer

Keep your Vale fridge freezer upright during transport and use two people to move it safely.

Before moving, unplug the appliance, remove all food and take out loose shelves and drawers. Allow any ice to melt naturally, then dry the inside thoroughly. Do not use sharp tools to remove ice.

Secure the doors with a strap or removable tape, and protect the cabinet with blankets. Keep the power cable off the floor. Never lift the appliance by its doors or handles.

At its destination, place the fridge freezer on a firm, level floor with space around it for ventilation. Leave it standing upright for at least 24 hours before plugging it in. Let it cool fully before replacing food.

Moving your Fenwick cooker hood

Before moving your Fenwick cooker hood, switch it off, allow it to cool and isolate it from the electricity supply. If it is hardwired, ask a qualified electrician to disconnect it.

Remove the grease filters and wrap them separately to prevent damage. Wear protective gloves when handling exposed metal edges.

Use two people to support the hood while removing its wall or cabinet fixings. Disconnect any ducting carefully, and keep screws and brackets together in a labelled bag.

Pack the hood in its original packaging if available, or use a sturdy box with padding on every side. Do not lift it by its controls or decorative panels.

Secure the packed unit during transport so it cannot slide or tip. Have it safely reinstalled before use.

Strange noises from your Vale fridge freezer

Some sounds are normal during use. A gentle hum comes from the compressor, while gurgling can occur as refrigerant moves through the cooling system. An occasional click can happen when cooling starts or stops.

If you hear rattling, check that bottles and containers are not touching each other. Move them apart, then check that shelves and drawers are seated properly.

Vibration may mean the appliance is touching nearby furniture or standing unevenly. Check that it is stable before adjusting the feet as described in your user manual.

If the noise is new, persistent or sounds like loud grinding, switch the appliance off and contact Halvard Home support. Do not remove any covers.

Using the Fenwick cooker hood timer

The Fenwick cooker hood’s timer keeps the fan running for 10 minutes, then switches it off automatically. Use it after cooking to help clear lingering steam and smells.

To set the timer:
1. Switch on the fan and select your preferred speed.
2. Press the timer button once to start the 10-minute countdown.
3. Leave the hood running; the fan will stop when the countdown ends.

To cancel the countdown, press the timer button again. You can also switch the fan off manually if you no longer need extraction.

This is a run-on timer, not a delay-start function: it does not switch the hood on at a later time.

Flashing warning light on your Orrin heat pump

A flashing warning light on your Orrin heat pump needs attention, but the light alone does not identify the cause.

First, check the thermostat display and write down any message before changing settings. Note whether the heat pump is still heating and when the flashing started.

From a safe position, check whether leaves, snow or other loose debris are blocking airflow around the outdoor unit. Do not remove covers, reach inside or chip away ice.

If the light keeps flashing, contact Halvard Home support with your observations. Avoid repeatedly restarting the heat pump.

If you notice smoke, a burning smell or unusual loud noises, stop using the system and seek professional help promptly.

articles.topic: the door or lid not closing
articles.text:
Orrin heat pump door or lid not closing

If the door or lid on your Halvard Home Orrin heat pump will not close, switch the unit off before checking it. Do not remove any service covers.

Check the closing edge for loose packaging, dirt or other visible obstructions. Packaging trapped between the lid and casing can prevent the latch from engaging. Remove only loose items that you can reach safely; do not move wires or internal components.

Gently close the door or lid, checking that it sits flush with the casing. Do not slam it, force the latch or tape it shut.

If the hinges look bent, the latch appears damaged or it still will not close, leave the unit off and contact Halvard Home support.

Pair your Vale fridge freezer with a voice assistant

Connect your Vale fridge freezer to the Halvard Home app before linking it to a voice assistant. Use a 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network during setup.

1. Open the Halvard Home app and check that your fridge freezer appears online.
2. Open your voice assistant’s app and find the section for adding smart home devices or services.
3. Search for Halvard Home, select it and sign in with the same account you use in the Halvard Home app.
4. Allow access, then ask the assistant to discover devices.

Give the appliance a simple name, such as “Kitchen fridge”, to make voice requests clearer. Available commands depend on your voice assistant. If pairing fails, check your internet connection and try linking the accounts again.

Updating your Orrin heat pump firmware

Firmware updates can improve how your Orrin heat pump works. Use only firmware supplied by Halvard Home for your exact model.

Before you start, note your model name and current firmware version, if it is shown on the controller. Check the update instructions supplied with the firmware, as the installation method may vary.

Keep the heat pump connected to its power supply throughout the update. Do not switch it off at the mains or reset the controller while installation is in progress.

Once the update finishes, follow any restart instructions and check that your usual heating settings are still correct.

If you cannot find the correct update or installation appears to stop, contact Halvard Home support before trying again.

Pair your Tessa dishwasher with a voice assistant

To pair your Tessa dishwasher, first add it to the Halvard Home app and check that it appears online. Keep your phone connected to your home Wi-Fi during setup.

1. Open your voice assistant’s app and find the option to add a device or link a service.
2. Search for Halvard Home, then select it.
3. Sign in with the same Halvard Home account you use for your dishwasher.
4. Allow the voice assistant to discover your appliances, then select your Tessa dishwasher.

Give the dishwasher a short, distinctive name, such as “Kitchen dishwasher”, so your assistant can recognise it.

If pairing fails, check that the dishwasher is online, then unlink and reconnect the Halvard Home service.

Connecting your Corra hob to Wi-Fi

Connect your Corra induction hob to a 2.4 GHz home Wi-Fi network. A 5 GHz-only network will not work.

Before starting, make sure the hob is switched on, all cooking zones are off and your phone is connected to the home network.

Open the Halvard Home app, choose **Add appliance**, then select **Corra induction hob**. Follow the on-screen instructions to put the hob into pairing mode. Select your home network and enter its Wi-Fi password exactly as shown on your router or network details.

Keep your phone near the hob until the app confirms the connection.

If pairing fails, check the password and Wi-Fi signal, then restart the app and try again.

Ordering a spare accessory for your Orrin heat pump

To request a spare accessory, contact Halvard Home customer support with the accessory name, your heat pump’s model details and your delivery postcode.

Before getting in touch, take one clear photo of the heat pump’s rating label. If you still have the original accessory, photograph that too. These images can help identify the correct replacement.

Ask support to confirm compatibility, availability, the total price including delivery, and the expected delivery time before you place your order. Do not choose an accessory by appearance alone, as similar items may not fit your model.

When your accessory arrives, check it against your order confirmation. Follow the supplied fitting instructions, and ask support for advice if fitting requires opening the heat pump’s casing.

Water leaking underneath your Fenwick cooker hood

Water beneath your cooker hood may be condensation: steam from cooking cools on the hood’s surfaces and turns into droplets.

If water is dripping, stop cooking and switch off the hood. If you can safely reach a dry socket or isolator, disconnect its power before wiping the underside. Do not touch wet switches or electrical connections.

Once the hood is cool, check whether the grease filters need cleaning. Follow the cleaning instructions in your user manual and let the filters dry fully before refitting them.

If the leak continues, occurs when you are not cooking, or appears to come from inside the hood, leave it switched off and contact Halvard Home support. Do not remove electrical covers or attempt internal repairs.

Energy saving settings for your Vale fridge freezer

Set the fridge to 4°C and the freezer to −18°C for everyday use. These temperatures keep food safely chilled or frozen without making the appliance work harder than necessary. Colder settings usually use more electricity.

If you have temporarily selected a colder setting for a large load of food, return to your usual setting once the food has chilled or frozen.

To help maintain a steady temperature, keep door openings brief and check that both doors close fully. Avoid blocking internal air vents with food or packaging.

Let hot food cool before placing it in the fridge, but refrigerate it within two hours. Keep the appliance away from direct sunlight and heat sources where possible.

Connecting your Lumen thermostat to wi-fi

To connect your Halvard Home Lumen smart thermostat, have your home wi-fi name and password ready. Use a 2.4 GHz network; the thermostat does not connect to a 5 GHz network.

On the thermostat, open Settings, select Wi-fi, then choose your home network from the list. Enter the password carefully, including any capital letters, and select Connect. A wi-fi symbol appears on the screen when the connection is complete.

If your network is not listed, check that your router is switched on and broadcasting its network name. If connection fails, check the password and restart your router before trying again.

Do not reset the thermostat as your first troubleshooting step, as this may remove your saved heating preferences.

Booking a Tessa dishwasher engineer visit

To book an engineer visit for your Tessa dishwasher, contact Halvard Home customer support and ask for a repair appointment.

Before you contact us, write down what happens when you start a wash. Tell us whether the dishwasher fills, drains or stops during the cycle. Have your address, contact number and proof of purchase ready, if available.

Customer support will discuss appointment availability and explain any call-out charges before you confirm the booking. Let us know about parking restrictions or difficult access to your home.

Before the engineer arrives, empty the dishwasher and clear the space in front of it. Do not pull out a built-in appliance yourself; leave it in place for the engineer.

Saving energy with your Brio kettle

Use your Brio kettle’s temperature setting to heat water only as much as you need. For green tea, select 80°C rather than boiling the water to 100°C. Follow the drink manufacturer’s brewing advice if it recommends a different temperature.

Switch off the keep-warm setting when you do not need hot water straight away. This stops the kettle using extra energy to maintain the selected temperature after heating.

Before filling, measure the water you need using your cup, then check that the level is between the kettle’s minimum and maximum marks. Never heat less than the minimum amount.

Descale regularly, especially in hard-water areas, to help the kettle heat efficiently.

Descaling your Mira robot vacuum

If your Mira has a water tank, check its care instructions before using any descaling product. Do not put kettle descaler, vinegar or other acidic cleaners into the tank unless those instructions specifically allow it.

Switch the vacuum off and remove it from its charging dock before cleaning. If the tank is removable, take it out and empty any remaining water. Gently wipe accessible limescale deposits with a soft cloth dampened with clean water. Do not immerse the robot or its charging dock.

Do not scrape deposits with a knife or other sharp tool, as this may damage surfaces or seals. If scale remains or water flow is reduced, contact Halvard Home support for guidance before trying a chemical treatment.

Cleaning your Vale fridge freezer filter

Before cleaning the filter, switch off your Vale fridge freezer at the socket and unplug it. Keep the doors closed while you work to help food stay cold.

Check your user guide for the filter’s location and removal instructions. Do not force the cover or filter out.

If the filter is marked as washable, rinse it gently under lukewarm running water. Avoid detergent, bleach and abrasive brushes. Leave it to air-dry completely before refitting; do not use a hairdryer or radiator.

If it is a disposable filter, replace it rather than washing it. Water filter cartridges must not be cleaned and reused.

Refit the filter and cover securely, then plug the appliance back in and switch it on.

Burning smell from your Corra induction hob

If you notice a burning smell, turn off the hob and let it cool completely. Food spills, grease or packaging left near a hot pan can cause a burning smell.

Once the surface is cool, remove any cookware and check for residue. Wipe the glass with a soft, damp cloth and a cleaner suitable for induction hobs, then dry it thoroughly. Do not clean the surface while it is hot.

If the smell resembles burning plastic or electrics, switch off the hob at the mains if safe to do so. Do not use it again until it has been checked.

Contact Halvard Home support if the smell continues or has no obvious cause.

Burning smell from your Brio kettle

If your Halvard Home Brio kettle smells as though it is burning, switch it off and unplug it immediately, if safe to do so. Do not boil it again to test whether the smell has gone.

Leave the kettle to cool for at least 30 minutes before checking it. Look for visible damage, discolouration or melted plastic around the plug, cable and base. Do not touch damaged electrical parts.

Once everything is cool, check that the outside of the kettle and its base are dry. Never immerse the base in water.

Stop using the kettle and contact Halvard Home support for advice before using it again. Describe when the smell started and whether you noticed smoke or unusual heat.

Ashby tumble dryer: using delay start

Delay start lets you postpone the beginning of a drying programme. A delay of 3 hours means the dryer waits 3 hours before starting; it does not mean your clothes will be dry in 3 hours.

To set a delay, load the drum, close the door and select your drying programme. Use the delay start control to choose the waiting time, then press Start to confirm.

If the dryer does not begin tumbling straight away, check whether a delay is active before assuming there is a fault. The waiting time and drying time are separate.

Only use delay start when you will be at home and awake throughout the drying cycle.

Resetting your Keel washing machine

A factory reset restores your Halvard Home Keel washing machine’s original settings and clears saved wash preferences. Make a note of any settings you want to use again before you begin.

1. Wait until the current programme has finished and remove your laundry.
2. Leave the machine switched on, with the drum empty.
3. Open **Settings** on the control panel.
4. Select **Factory reset**, then choose **Confirm**.
5. Allow the machine to restart before selecting another programme.

You will need to set your preferred options again after the reset.

If the control panel does not respond or the reset option is unavailable, contact Halvard Home support. Do not remove any covers or attempt to reset internal components yourself.

Keel washing machine display stays blank

If your Halvard Home Keel washing machine’s display stays blank, first check that the plug is fully inserted and the wall socket is switched on. With dry hands, press the machine’s power button once.

If nothing happens, switch off the socket and unplug the machine for five minutes. Plug it back in, switch on the socket and press the power button again.

If the display is still blank, check whether another appliance works in the same socket. A socket without power cannot supply the washing machine.

Do not remove the machine’s panels or attempt internal repairs. If the socket works but the display remains blank, contact Halvard Home support. If you notice scorching or a burning smell, stop using the machine.

Ashby tumble dryer drying slowly

If your Ashby tumble dryer is taking longer than usual or leaving clothes damp, start by checking airflow and the load.

Switch off and unplug the dryer before cleaning. Remove lint from the filter after every load: a blocked filter restricts airflow and can slow drying. Refit the filter securely before using the dryer again.

Avoid packing the drum tightly. Clothes need room to tumble so warm air can move between them. Separate heavy towels from lighter fabrics, and use your washing machine’s spin cycle to remove excess water before drying.

Check that any external ventilation openings are clear. If drying remains weak after these checks, contact Halvard Home support. Stop using the dryer if you notice a burning smell.

Booking an engineer visit

To arrange an engineer visit for your Ashby tumble dryer, contact Halvard Home customer support and ask to book a repair.

Before contacting us, write down the dryer’s serial number and a short description of the problem. Include when it started and whether the dryer still switches on. Have your address, contact number and proof of purchase ready, if available.

Ask the support adviser to confirm the appointment date, arrival window and any charges before you agree to the booking. Let them know about stairs, parking restrictions or other access needs.

On the day, clear the space around the dryer so the engineer can reach it safely. If you need to change the appointment, contact customer support as soon as possible.

Fenwick cooker hood: power cut during use

If the power fails while your Fenwick cooker hood is running, the fan and any hood lights will stop working.

Set the hood’s fan and light controls to off. If the controls do not respond without power, switch off the hood at its wall isolator, if accessible. This helps prevent an unexpected restart when electricity returns.

Turn off your hob and pause cooking while extraction is unavailable. Open a window if it is safe to do so.

Once power is restored, switch the hood’s supply back on, then test the fan and lights.

If the hood still does not work, check whether other kitchen appliances have power. Do not remove covers or touch wiring. Contact Halvard Home support for further help.

Cleaning your Orrin heat pump filter

A clean filter helps your Orrin heat pump maintain airflow and work efficiently. Check the filter once a month, or more often if your home is dusty or you have pets.

Before cleaning, switch off the heat pump and isolate its power supply. Wait until the fan has stopped.

Open the user-accessible filter panel and gently remove the filter. Do not remove fixed covers. Use a vacuum cleaner with a soft brush attachment to lift dust from both sides without pressing hard.

Do not wash the filter unless it is marked as washable. Replace it if it is torn or damaged.

Refit the filter securely, close the panel, then restore power. Never run the heat pump without its filter.

Lumen thermostat display stays blank

If your Lumen smart thermostat display stays blank, start by checking its power supply. A loss of power can leave the display completely blank.

Try these checks in order:

- Tap the display once to check whether it is simply asleep.
- If your thermostat uses replaceable batteries, fit fresh batteries of the type shown inside the battery compartment. Match the positive and negative markings.
- If it is mains-powered, check whether the heating system’s power switch is on. Do not remove the thermostat cover or touch any wiring.

If the display remains blank, contact Halvard Home support and explain which checks you have completed. If you notice heat, a burning smell or damaged wiring, stop using the thermostat and seek help from a qualified electrician.

articles.topic: using it in a holiday home
articles.text:
Using your Orrin in a holiday home

Keep your Orrin heat pump connected to the electricity supply while your holiday home is empty during cold weather. Switching it off at the mains can prevent frost protection from working.

Before leaving, clear leaves and other debris from around the outdoor unit so air can circulate freely. Check that doors and windows are closed.

If your controller has a holiday setting, use it to reduce heating while you are away. Otherwise, choose a lower room temperature rather than switching the heating off completely. Follow your installer’s advice on a suitable temperature for the property.

Allow time for the home to warm up when you return; heat pumps generally heat rooms gradually.

Flashing light on your Corra induction hob

A flashing cooking-zone light can mean the hob is not detecting a suitable pan. Check that a pan is centred on the selected zone and that its base is clean and dry.

Use induction-compatible cookware. A magnet sticking firmly to the pan’s base is a useful check for compatibility. Switch the zone off before repositioning or replacing the pan, and use oven gloves if it is hot.

If the light still flashes, turn the hob off using its controls and allow it to cool. Wipe away any moisture covering the control area, then try again.

If the warning continues, stop using the hob and contact Halvard Home support. Describe which light flashes and when it happens.

Energy-saving settings for Lumen

Use a heating schedule on your Halvard Home Lumen smart thermostat to match your daily routine. Set lower temperatures for times when you are out or asleep, rather than keeping the same temperature all day.

Try setting your daytime heating temperature to 19°C, then adjust it for comfort. Some people, including older adults and those with health conditions, may need a warmer home.

Review your schedule when your routine changes. If you use a temporary temperature override, return to the schedule afterwards so the higher setting does not continue unnecessarily.

Avoid turning the temperature up sharply to warm a room faster: a higher target does not make most heating systems heat more quickly. Keep furniture and curtains clear of the thermostat for accurate readings.

# Mira robot vacuum display stays blank

If your Mira robot vacuum’s display stays blank, first check that its charging dock is plugged into a working wall socket and switched on.

Place the vacuum on the dock, making sure its charging contacts line up with those on the dock. Leave it to charge for 30 minutes, then press the vacuum’s power button.

If the display still does not light up, unplug the dock and wipe the charging contacts on both the vacuum and dock with a soft, dry cloth. Do not use water or cleaning spray. Reconnect the dock and try charging again.

If there is still no response, contact Halvard Home support. Do not open the vacuum or attempt electrical repairs.

Ashby tumble dryer display stays blank

If your Ashby tumble dryer’s display stays blank, check its power supply first.

1. Make sure the plug is fully inserted and the wall socket is switched on. Use a wall socket directly, not an extension lead.
2. Check whether a circuit breaker has tripped at your consumer unit. If it trips again, stop using the dryer and contact a qualified electrician.
3. Switch the dryer off at the socket and unplug it for five minutes. Reconnect it, switch the socket on, then press the dryer’s power button.

If the plug or cable looks damaged, do not reconnect the dryer.

If the display remains blank, contact Halvard Home support. Do not remove any panels or attempt internal repairs.

Brio kettle heating slowly

If your Brio kettle takes longer than usual to boil, limescale build-up may be reducing heat transfer to the water.

Unplug the kettle and let it cool before checking inside. If you see chalky deposits, use a descaler suitable for kettles and follow the instructions on its packaging. Rinse the kettle twice with fresh water afterwards, then boil fresh water and discard it before making a drink.

For quicker boiling, fill only with the amount you need, keeping the water between the minimum and maximum marks. Make sure the lid is fully closed.

If heating remains slow after descaling, stop using the kettle and contact Halvard Home support. Do not open the base or attempt electrical repairs.

Ordering a spare accessory for your Vale fridge freezer

To order a spare accessory, contact Halvard Home customer support with your fridge freezer’s model details and the name of the item you need, such as a shelf, drawer or door tray.

Before contacting support, take one clear photo of the accessory and one of the space where it fits. If the accessory is missing, photograph the empty space instead. This helps support identify the right replacement.

Ask support to confirm compatibility, the total price including delivery, and the expected delivery time before placing your order. Do not choose an accessory by appearance alone, as similar items may have different fittings.

Keep your order confirmation until the replacement arrives and you have checked that it fits.

# Strange noises from your Orrin heat pump

A gentle hum or airflow sound is usually normal while your Orrin heat pump is running. A brief whoosh can occur when the unit changes operating mode.

If you hear an unfamiliar rattle, switch the heat pump off using its normal controls before checking around the outdoor unit. Look for loose objects nearby, such as plant pots or garden furniture, and move anything touching the casing. Do not remove panels or reach through the grille.

Restart the heat pump once the area is clear. If the noise continues, contact Halvard Home support and describe when it happens.

For loud grinding, scraping or repeated banging, stop using the heat pump and arrange a professional inspection.

Recycling your old Lumen smart thermostat

Recycle your old Lumen smart thermostat as electrical waste, not in your household rubbish bin. Take it to a local recycling centre that accepts small electrical appliances. Check your council’s website for opening times and any booking requirements before travelling.

If the thermostat is still installed and wired into your heating system, ask a qualified electrician or heating engineer to disconnect it safely. Do not cut wires or open the casing yourself.

If the unit still works, use its factory reset option to clear saved settings before recycling. Remove it from your smart home account too.

Remove any batteries only if they are designed to be user-removable. Recycle these separately at a battery collection point.

Burning smell from your Keel washing machine

Stop using your Keel washing machine immediately if you notice a burning smell. Switch it off and unplug it, but only if you can do so safely. Do not touch a plug or socket that appears scorched, damaged or sparking.

A burning smell can indicate overheating or an electrical fault. Do not run another cycle to see whether the smell clears, and do not remove any panels or attempt repairs yourself.

Contact Halvard Home support to arrange an inspection before using the machine again. Describe when the smell started and whether you noticed unusual noise or smoke.

If there is smoke or fire, leave the property and call 999. Never use water on an electrical fire.

Fenwick cooker hood: using the child lock

The child lock prevents accidental changes to your Fenwick cooker hood’s controls. It does not act as a physical barrier, so keep children away from the hob and hot cookware.

To switch the child lock on, press and hold the padlock button for three seconds. A lock symbol appears on the display to confirm that the controls are locked.

To unlock the controls, press and hold the padlock button again for three seconds. Wait for the lock symbol to disappear before selecting a fan speed or changing the light.

If the controls do not respond, make sure your fingers and the control panel are clean and dry, then try unlocking again.

Fault message on your Vale fridge freezer

A fault message on the display means your Vale fridge freezer has detected a problem that may need attention.

First, note exactly what the display shows, or take a clear photo. Check that both doors close fully and that food or packaging is not blocking the internal air vents.

If you have an appliance thermometer, check the temperature: the fridge should be at 5°C or below, and the freezer at −18°C.

Keep the doors closed as much as possible while checking the issue. Do not remove panels or attempt electrical repairs.

If the message remains, contact Halvard Home support with the display details and explain whether either compartment has stopped cooling.

Tessa dishwasher: power cut during use

A power cut stops the wash cycle because your Tessa dishwasher needs electricity to run its pump. Leave the door closed during the cut, as the water and dishes may still be hot.

When power returns:

- Check that the dishwasher’s wall socket is switched on.
- Look at the controls to see whether the programme has resumed or needs restarting.
- If washing resumes, leave the door closed and let the programme finish.
- If the programme has ended before the dishes are clean, select a new wash programme.

If the dishwasher remains unresponsive, switch it off at the wall and contact Halvard Home support. If you notice leaking water or a burning smell, stop using it.

Brio kettle: unusual vibration

If your Brio kettle vibrates unusually, switch it off and unplug the base before checking it. Allow the kettle to cool completely.

An uneven surface can make a kettle rock and amplify vibration. Place the base on a dry, flat, stable worktop, away from the edge. Check that the kettle sits securely on its base and that nothing is trapped underneath.

Check the water level against the kettle’s minimum and maximum marks. Do not run it below the minimum or fill it above the maximum.

If vibration continues after these checks, stop using the kettle and contact Halvard Home support. Stop immediately if you also notice leaking, a burning smell or visible damage. Do not open or attempt to repair the base.

Cleaning your Lumen smart thermostat

Your Lumen smart thermostat does not need descaling. Descaling products are for removing mineral deposits from water-handling equipment, not for cleaning the thermostat.

To clean the outside safely:

- Switch off the thermostat’s power supply before cleaning.
- Gently wipe the display and casing with a soft, dry cloth.
- Do not spray liquid onto the thermostat or use vinegar, descaler, abrasive cleaners or a steam cleaner.
- Do not open the casing to clean inside.

If you suspect limescale is affecting your heating or hot water, the thermostat is not the place to treat it. Check the care instructions for your boiler or water heater, or ask a qualified heating engineer. Do not add descaling chemicals to your heating system without professional guidance.

Unusual vibration from your Fenwick cooker hood

An unusual vibration may be caused by a grease filter that is not seated correctly, or by an object touching the hood.

Switch the hood off and isolate it from the electricity supply before checking it. Allow the hob and hood to cool.

Remove any items resting on or touching the hood. Check that the grease filters sit flat and their catches are fully engaged. Do not remove the outer casing or adjust internal components.

Restore the power and run the hood on its lowest speed for 30 seconds. If the vibration continues, switch it off again and contact Halvard Home support. Tell us whether the vibration changes with fan speed and whether it started after cleaning.

Frost or condensation on your Lumen thermostat

Condensation forms when warm, damp air meets a cold surface. Moisture on your Lumen smart thermostat may indicate high humidity or a cold draught nearby.

Gently wipe the outside with a soft, dry cloth. Do not spray cleaner onto the thermostat, use a hairdryer or scrape away frost.

To reduce further build-up:
- Use an extractor fan when cooking or showering.
- Keep wet laundry away from the thermostat.
- Check for draughts around nearby windows and doors, without blocking ventilation grilles.

If frost returns, ask a qualified heating installer to check whether the thermostat’s position is suitable.

If moisture appears inside the display, or the controls stop responding, stop using the controls and contact Halvard Home support for advice.

Brio kettle display staying blank

If your Brio kettle’s display stays blank, check the power supply first. Make sure the plug is fully inserted and the wall socket is switched on.

Switch off the socket and unplug the kettle. Leave it unplugged for five minutes before trying again. While it is disconnected, check that the base and the underside of the kettle are dry. Never immerse the base in water.

Place the kettle firmly on its base, reconnect the plug and switch on the socket. If the display remains blank, try a different socket that you know works.

Stop using the kettle if the cable is damaged or you notice a burning smell. Contact Halvard Home support if these checks do not restore the display.

articles.topic: using it in a holiday home
articles.text:
Using your Brio kettle in a holiday home

Before using your Brio kettle, check that the cable, plug and base are dry and undamaged. Place the base on a stable, level surface, away from the sink and the edge of the worktop.

If the kettle has been left unused, empty any old water and rinse the inside. Fill with fresh drinking water between the minimum and maximum marks, boil it, then discard that water before making drinks.

Never switch the kettle on when empty or fill it above the maximum mark. Keep the lid closed while boiling.

Before leaving the holiday home, unplug the kettle, let it cool and empty it. Leave it clean and dry, ready for your next stay.

Water leaking under your Tessa dishwasher

If water is leaking underneath your Tessa dishwasher, stop the programme and turn off the water supply using the dishwasher’s isolation valve. Switch off the electricity only if you can reach the switch safely without standing in water or touching wet surfaces.

Once the area is safe, wipe up the water to prevent slips. Check the door seal for trapped food and clean it with a damp cloth. Look for visible drips from accessible hose connections, but do not pull out the dishwasher or remove panels.

Use only detergent made for dishwashers. Washing-up liquid can create excessive foam and cause leaks.

Do not run another cycle while the leak remains unexplained. Contact Halvard Home support to arrange an inspection if the source is unclear.
